Name: Pyramid
Description: A well-behaved pyramid workout with predictable changes and steady pacing. Designed to keep the brain calm and the legs engaged without tipping into fatigue.
ChineseDescription:
一个表现良好的金字塔锻炼与可预测的变化和稳定的节奏。
旨在保持大脑平静和腿部参与,而不会陷入疲劳。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
A well-behaved pyramid workout with predictable changes and steady pacing. Designed to keep the brain calm and the legs engaged without tipping into fatigue.

Name: 100min Spin 90 and 80
Description: A quiet, unhurried ride with subtle cadence shifts. Nothing to chase, nothing to force—just steady movement that helps your body reset over time and brings your legs back to balance. no pull, no push, just roll
ChineseDescription:
一个安静,不慌不忙的骑行与微妙的踏频变化。
没有什么可追逐的,没有什么可以强迫的 - 只是稳定的运动,可以帮助你的身体随着时间的推移重置,并使你的腿恢复平衡。
没有拉,没有推,只是滚动

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
A quiet, unhurried ride with subtle cadence shifts. Nothing to chase, nothing to force—just steady movement that helps your body reset over time and brings your legs back to balance. no pull, no push, just roll

Name: 10min Best effort!
Description:
This is your day to produce your best 10min effort! After warming up and completing 2 x 5min sub-threshold efforts, you will face a 10min effort with no target power. 

This is your chance to ride how you feel, implementing effective pacing, to record your best 10-minute power.
ChineseDescription:
这是你创造你最好的10分钟训练段的一天!
热身并完成2×5分钟的阈值以下训练段后,您将面临10分钟的训练段,没有目标功率。
这是你骑你的感觉,实施有效的配速,记录你最好的10分钟功率的机会。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This is your day to produce your best 10min effort! After warming up and completing 2 x 5min sub-threshold efforts, you will face a 10min effort with no target power. 

This is your chance to ride how you feel, implementing effective pacing, to record your best 10-minute power.

Name: 10min Ramps
Description:
Your ability to perform long efforts with some intensity is a significant factor in your cycling performance. They require good physical condition, along with the ability to stay focused. 

Today's session has 3 x 10min efforts that either increase or decrease in intensity.

你以某种强度进行长时间训练段的能力是自行车表现的一个重要因素。
它们需要良好的身体状况,以及保持专注的能力。
今天的训练有3 x 10min的训练段,增加或减少强度。

After completing a good warm-up, we perform 4 x 11-minute Intensive Aerobic intervals.

Name: 12min 30/30's #1
Description: Another session of intermittent training, performing 30/30s for an accumulated time of 18 min above threshold. After warming up, we complete three sets of 12-minute blocks of 30 seconds above FTP, followed by 30 seconds of recovery. The rest period mustn't be too easy to train the muscle fibres to use the lactate produced as a fuel.
ChineseDescription:
另一节间歇训练,执行30/30秒的累积时间超过阈值18分钟。
热身后,我们完成了三组12分钟的块,比FTP高30秒,然后是30秒的恢复。
休息时间不能太容易训练肌肉纤维使用产生的乳酸作为燃料。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: 12min Over-Under's
Description:
Today's workout focuses on developing threshold power. We complete 2 x 12-minute intervals with the target power moving just above and below your FTP. 

This is a high-intensity workout requiring you to concentrate on the changes in target power and the increased fatigue as the interval progresses.
ChineseDescription:
今天的锻炼重点是开发阈值能力。
我们完成 2 x 12 分钟的间歇,目标功率在 FTP 上方和下方移动。
这是一个高强度的锻炼,要求你专注于目标功率的变化和增加的疲劳随着时间间歇的进展。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

This is a high-intensity workout requiring you to concentrate on the changes in target power and the increased fatigue as the interval progresses.

Name: 13min Progressive Climb
Description:
There are three climbs of 13 minutes in duration today, but each is completed using a different cadence. As the power ramps up between steps, select your cadence before returning to the target cadence. 

Position yourself on the bike as you would on a long climb. Like a climb outdoors, the required power will increase throughout the 13 minutes. We culminate with a 1 min above threshold at the top of the climb.
ChineseDescription:
今天有三次攀登13分钟的持续时间,但每次攀登都使用不同的踏频完成。
当功率在步骤之间增加时,在返回到目标踏频之前选择你的踏频。
把自己放在自行车上,就像你在漫长的攀登中一样。
就像在户外攀爬一样,所需的功率将在13分钟内增加。
我们达到高潮,在攀登的顶部超过1分钟的阈值。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: 15分钟变踏频节奏训练 #1
Description:
本次训练在第3区（节奏区）改变踏频和功率。请观察15分钟间歇中的心率，留意踏频变化时心率如何响应。

今天的功率处于该训练区间的较低端，额外的训练负荷来自目标踏频。

Name: 15min Varied Tempo #2
Description:
Today, working in your Zone 3 Tempo, we vary the cadence and power. Observe your Heart Rate during the 15-minute interval and look for changes in your Heart Rate when the cadence varies. 

We are working at the lower end of the training Zone today. The added stress comes from the target cadence.

我们今天在训练区的低端工作。
增加的压力来自目标节奏。

Name: 15min Varied Tempo #3
Description:
Today, working in your Tempo zone, we are varying the cadence and power. However, start each 5min effort with a 'high-speed sprint'. Out of the saddle for the sprint, then straight into the tempo effort. 

Observe your HR during the 15min intervals and look for changes in heart rate when your cadence changes.

走出马鞍冲刺,然后直接进入速度的训练段。
在15分钟的间歇内观察您的HR,并在节奏变化时寻找心率的变化。

Name: 1min + Endurance #1
Description: Today we are going to burn up the intramuscular glycogen early in the session and then continue with an endurance ride. By depleting this energy source early, the body is forced to adapt by becoming more efficient at utilising fats to produce the power. In this workout the 1min efforts also act as part of your warm up. We quickly get into the action today! The remaining endurance ride is completed as a free-ride. Aim to keep your effort within zone 2 and 3 for the majority of your ride.
ChineseDescription:
今天,我们将在训练早期燃烧肌肉内糖原,然后继续耐力骑行。
通过尽早消耗这种能量源,身体被迫通过更有效地利用脂肪来产生能量来适应。
在这个锻炼1分钟的训练段也作为你热身的一部分。
我们今天迅速采取行动!
剩余的耐力骑行作为自由骑行完成。
训练段保持你的训练段在区域2和3你的大部分骑行。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

In this workout the 1min efforts also act as part of your warm up. We quickly get into the action today! The remaining endurance ride is completed as a free-ride. Aim to keep your effort within zone 2 and 3 for the majority of your ride.

Name: 2023 TDF Alena Amialiusik - Taper
Description:
In her rich career, Alena Amialiusik boasts numerous victories and results, including a gold medal at European Games Road Race, a bronze medal in the Road European Championship, countless National titles, and the TTT World Championships. 

A significant part of this success is knowing how to taper effectively, leading into an important block of racing. 

In today's workout, we look at the training Amialiusik would complete before a major stage race.
ChineseDescription:
在她丰富的职业生涯中,Alena Amialiusik拥有无数的胜利和结果,包括欧洲运动会公路赛金牌,欧洲公路锦标赛铜牌,无数的国家冠军和TTT世界锦标赛。
这一成功的一个重要部分是知道如何有效地缩小,导致一个重要的赛车块。
在今天的锻炼中,我们看看Amialiusik将在重大舞台比赛之前完成的训练。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: 2023 TDF Chiara Consonni - Sprint
Description:
Chiara is a pure sprinter. She is the new arrow for the sprints at UAE Team ADQ. A multiple European and world champion on the track, she has already achieved several career victories on the road, including a stage at the Giro d'Italia. 

To target peak 5-sec power, Chiara will perform multiple maximal sprints in a single workout. In today's workout, we ride at a lower-end Tempo effort for 30 minutes. However, within these 30 minutes, you will perform a 10-second sprint every 5 minutes. 

Can you hit the same Peak Power for all six sprints?
ChineseDescription:
Chiara是一个纯粹的冲刺型车手。
她是阿联酋ADQ团队冲刺的新箭头。
作为赛道上的多个欧洲和世界冠军,她已经在路上取得了几场职业生涯的胜利,包括在Giro d'Italia的舞台上。
为了达到5秒的峰值功率,Chiara将在一次锻炼中执行多个最大冲刺。
在今天的锻炼中,我们以低端速度骑行30分钟。
然而,在这30分钟内,您将每5分钟进行一次10秒的冲刺。
你能在所有六个冲刺中达到相同的峰值功率吗?

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Can you hit the same Peak Power for all six sprints?

Name: 2023 TDF Erica Magnaldi - Climbing
Description:
Erica Magnaldi is a remarkable climber who has achieved impressive feats in her career. She has worked hard to earn an impressive third-place spot in the Mediterranean games a tenth-place standing on the General Classification at the Giro Donne and even snagged a stage win at the Tour de lArhe. 

To be a fierce competitor in the GC Erica knows she must hone her climbing skills through rigorous training. In this particular workout we focus on the demands of climbing and sprinting for Queen of the Mountain (QOM) points. 

We aim to replicate the climbing demands during the tempo effort by riding with a lower cadence. It's important to position yourself on the bike as you would during a long climb.
ChineseDescription:
Erica Magnaldi是一位非凡的登山者,在她的职业生涯中取得了令人印象深刻的成就。
她一直在训练段在地中海比赛中获得令人印象深刻的第三名位置,在Giro Donne的General Classification中排名第十,甚至在Tour de lArhe获得了舞台胜利。
要成为GC Erica的激烈竞争对手,她必须通过严格的训练来磨练她的攀岩技巧。
在这个特殊的锻炼中,我们专注于攀登和冲刺的山女王(QOM)点的要求。
我们的目标是通过以较低的节奏骑行来复制速度训练段期间的攀岩需求。
重要的是要把自己定位在自行车上,就像你在漫长的攀登中一样。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

To be a fierce competitor in the GC Erica knows she must hone her climbing skills through rigorous training. In this particular workout we focus on the demands of climbing and sprinting for Queen of the Mountain (QOM) points. 

We aim to replicate the climbing demands during the tempo effort by riding with a lower cadence. It's important to position yourself on the bike as you would during a long climb.

Name: 2023 TDF George Bennett - Climbing
Description:
George Bennett, a seasoned General Classification rider, understands the significance of perfecting his climbing fitness. The workout scheduled for today entails three 10-minute climbs, with every ascent executed at a target cadence.

Like an outdoor climb, the power demanded will escalate for 10 minutes, culminating in 1 minute above the threshold at the climb's summit.

Assume a bike position as you would during a long climb.
ChineseName: 2023 TDF 乔治·贝内特 - 攀登
ChineseDescription:
经验丰富的通用分类骑手乔治·贝内特(George Bennett)理解完善他的攀岩能力的重要性。
今天计划进行的锻炼需要三次10分钟的攀登,每次攀登都以目标踏频执行。
就像室外攀登一样,所需的功率将升级10分钟,最终在攀登山顶的阈值上方1分钟。
假设一个自行车的位置,你会在漫长的攀登。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
George Bennett, a seasoned General Classification rider, understands the significance of perfecting his climbing fitness. The workout scheduled for today entails three 10-minute climbs, with every ascent executed at a target cadence.

Like an outdoor climb, the power demanded will escalate for 10 minutes, culminating in 1 minute above the threshold at the climb's summit.

Assume a bike position as you would during a long climb.

Name: 2023 TDF Marta Bastianelli - Rouleur
Description:
Grand Tours provide fans with some of the most entertaining racing of the year. But for the riders, they are some of the most challenging events of the year, requiring detailed preparation and physically demanding training. 

In this workout, we replicate one of Marta Bastianelli's final training sessions leading into a Grand Tour. Marta's achievements include; the World, European and Italian Championships. She certainly knows how to prepare for the biggest events on the world stage!

但对于骑手来说,他们是一年中最具挑战性的事件之一,需要详细的准备和身体要求严格的培训。
在这次训练中,我们复制了Marta Bastianelli最后训练课程之一,然后进入Grand Tour。
玛尔塔的成就包括世界,欧洲和意大利锦标赛。
她当然知道如何为世界舞台上最大的事件做准备!

Name: 2023 TDF Matteo Trentin - Rouleur
Description:
Matteo Trentin is no stranger to the rigors of Grand Tour events, having participated in many of them before. As a key member of Tadej Pogacar's team, Trentin strategically plans his season to ensure he is in peak condition for the Tour de France. 

Our workout mimics the training regimen that Trentin performs leading up to a Grand Tour, helping to elevate his performance to the highest level.

我们的锻炼模仿了Trentin在大巡回赛前进行的训练方案,帮助将他的表现提升到最高水平。

Name: 2023 TDF Mikayla Harvey - ITT
Description:
Mikayla is a skilled ITT and GC specialist who has achieved remarkable results in her career. She secured fifth place in GC at the 2020 Giro d'Italia and seventh at La Fleche Wallone Femenine in the same year. She also previously won the Oceania ITT championship and New Zealand national ITT championship in the Under-23 Women and Junior categories. 

In this workout. We guide you through a crucial session that Mikayla undertakes to gear up for the ITT of a Grand Tour. The initial 8-minute sub-threshold efforts will help you prepare for the final 5-minute FTP interval.
ChineseName: 训练课程：2023 TDF Mikayla Harvey - ITT

她在2020年意大利Giro d'Italia获得GC第五名,同年在La Fleche Wallone Femenine获得第七名。
她之前还赢得了大洋洲ITT锦标赛和新西兰全国ITT锦标赛的U23女子和Junior类别。
在这个锻炼。
我们指导您完成Mikayla承诺为Grand Tour的ITT做准备的重要训练。
最初的8分钟子阈值训练段将帮助您为最后5分钟的FTP间歇做好准备。

In this workout, we are going to follow one of Mikkel's final training sessions leading into a major Grand Tour Time Trial.

Name: 2023 TDF Pascal Ackermann - Sprint
Description:
Pascal Ackermann has achieved numerous Grand Tour and Classic sprint victories, showcasing his impressive power when necessary. As the race comes to its climactic final kilometre, spectators are on the edge of their seats watching riders fight to maintain their positions behind their lead-out train. 

However, the true preparation for this intense sprint begins much earlier, with the speed ramping up within the last 20km of the race. To truly unleash his maximum sprint potential, Pascal must train to optimize his efficiency during this crucial final hour of racing. 

The UAE Team Emirates workout plan focuses on four brief yet highly intense intervals that gradually increase in power following a steady 10-minute Tempo effort.

Pascal Ackermann取得了许多大巡回赛和经典冲刺胜利,在必要时展示了他令人印象深刻的功率。
随着比赛进入高潮的最后一公里,观众们站在座位的边缘,观看车手们在领先火车后面训练段保持他们的位置。
然而,这场激烈的冲刺的真正准备开始的时间要早得多,速度在比赛的最后20公里内加快了。
为了真正发挥他最大的冲刺潜力,帕斯卡必须训练,在这个关键的比赛最后时刻优化他的效率。
阿联酋阿联酋队的锻炼计划侧重于四个短暂但高度紧张的间歇,在稳定的10分钟节奏训练段后逐渐增加功率。

Name: 2023 TDF Vegard Laengen - Domestique
Description:
Vegard Laengen is the trusty workhorse of UAE Team Emirates. Throughout a Grand Tour, Laengen will spend countless hours riding at the head of the peloton, controlling the speed for his team leader. 

There is no getting away from the benefits of completing long steady Tempo efforts. The best professionals spend countless hours training this way, and Laengen spends much of his training toiling away in this zone 3 power. 

By completing some 1-minute near FTP efforts in the warm-up, you will be ready for the following 15-minute Tempo efforts.

没有摆脱完成长期稳定的Tempo训练段的好处。
最好的专业人士花费无数个小时以这种方式训练,而Laengen花费他的大部分训练在这个区域3的功率。
通过在热身中完成大约1分钟的FTP工作,您将为接下来的15分钟的Tempo工作做好准备。

Name: 20min Tempo w/15sec Accelerations
Description:
Completing long tempo efforts with short, high-intensity surges is another way to increase threshold power. The body must process the lactate produced from the above threshold surges with the constant high power. 

A practical session without the lung burning effect of a sustained threshold effort.

ChineseDescription:

身体必须以恒定的高功率处理上述阈值浪涌产生的乳酸。
一个实际的训练没有持续的阈值训练段的肺燃烧效果。

Name: 20sec + Endurance #1
Description: Today we are going to burn up the intramuscular glycogen early in the session and then continue with an endurance ride. By depleting this energy source early, the body is forced to adapt by becoming more efficient at utilising fats to produce the power. In this workout the 20 second efforts also act as part of your warm up. We quickly get into the action today! The remaining endurance ride is completed as a free-ride. Aim to keep your effort within zone 2 and 3 for the majority of your ride.

在这个锻炼中,20秒的训练段也作为你热身的一部分。
我们今天迅速采取行动!
剩余的耐力骑行作为自由骑行完成。
训练段保持你的训练段在区域2和3你的大部分骑行。

Aim to keep your effort within zone 2 and 3 for the majority of your ride.

Description:
There's no getting away from the benefits of long aerobic efforts. This Intensive Aerobic duration is the point where most of the energy comes from aerobic pathways. 

After completing a good warm-up, we perform 3 x 22-minute Intensive Aerobic intervals.

Name: 25sec Intensive Anaerobic
Description:
Your ability to produce high power efforts above threshold is a significant factor in racing. This session focuses on Intensive Anaerobic efforts of 25sec. Because we are looking for maximal efforts in this area, full recovery is provided between each interval. 

While the session might look simple on paper, don't be fooled. This is a High-Intensity session with maximal effort. However, to help you judge your effort for this duration, you will be guided through the opening intervals before being provided with the opportunity to produce your best efforts in the finale.
ChineseDescription:
你的能力产生高于阈值的高功率训练段是赛车的一个重要因素。
本次训练的重点是25秒的强化无氧训练段。
因为我们正在寻找在这一领域的最大训练段,在每个间歇之间提供完全恢复。
虽然训练在纸面上看起来很简单,但不要被愚弄。
这是一个具有最大训练段的高强度训练。
然而,为了帮助你判断你在这期间的训练段,你将被引导通过开放时间间歇,然后有机会在决赛中产生你最大的训练段。

Name: 2min Anaerobic Capacity

A shorter workout today that is high on quality! A challenging session today, with the focus on completing two quality Anaerobic Capacity intervals. 

These are high-intensity efforts with the power ramping up over 2min, starting at 88% of FTP and finishing at 130% of FTP.

Name: 30min Sub-Threshold
Description: Sub-threshold intervals are an integral part of building aerobic endurance. Completing sub-threshold intervals results in a high oxygen consumption which provides the boost to your aerobic system. This is an important aspect of your preparation.

完成亚阈值间歇会导致高耗氧量,从而提高您的有氧系统。
这是你准备的一个重要方面。

Name: 30sec + Endurance #1
Description: Today we are going to burn up the intramuscular glycogen early in the session and then continue with an endurance ride. By depleting this energy source early, the body is forced to adapt by becoming more efficient at utilising fats to produce the power. In this workout the 30 second efforts also act as part of your warm up. We quickly get into the action today! The remaining endurance ride is completed as a free-ride. Aim to keep your effort within zone 2 and 3 for the majority of your ride.

在这个锻炼中,30秒的训练段也作为你热身的一部分。
我们今天迅速采取行动!
剩余的耐力骑行作为自由骑行完成。
训练段保持你的训练段在区域2和3你的大部分骑行。

Name: 40/20 Efforts
Description: 40/20 efforts are completed at a power just below your Maximal Aerobic Power (MAP). By splitting the effort into 40 seconds of work, with 20 seconds of recovery, you can accumulate more time at this intensity than you would if doing it as a continuous effort. This is a development of the previous week's 30/30 session - a higher workload this week!
ChineseDescription:
40/20 的训练段是在功率刚好低于您的最大有氧功率 (MAP) 完成的。
通过将工作分成40秒的工作,20秒的恢复,你可以积累更多的时间在这个强度比如果你这样做作为一个持续的训练段。
这是前一周的30/30训练的发展 - 本周的工作量更高!

Name: 40/20's #1
Description: The 40/20 sessions consist of 40sec above your threshold pace, followed by 20sec of rest. By continually lifting power above what is comfortable, you will improve your ability to recover from hard efforts, along with improving your VO2max capacity. Monitor your heart rate before and after each interval. Has heart rate increased significantly over the course of the efforts?
ChineseDescription:
40/20训练包括40秒以上的阈值速度,其次是20秒的休息。
通过不断提升超过舒适感的功率,您将提高从艰苦训练段中恢复的能力,同时提高您的VO2max容量。
在每个间歇之前和之后监测你的心率。
在训练段的过程中,心率是否显着增加?

This is a long day in the breakaway today!

Name: 4min 30/30's
Description:
This type of training is a very effective method to improve your VO2max abilities while also focusing on high rpm pedalling. By performing short, mild intensity efforts with brief recovery, we can trigger the effects of oxygen debt without the high levels of fatigue that come with longer intervals. 

Riders often use this workout to bring them into top form, with its calculated balance of work and rest during the interval period.
ChineseDescription:
这种类型的训练是一种非常有效的方法来提高您的VO2max能力,同时也专注于高转速踏板。
通过执行短,轻度的强度训练段和短暂的恢复,我们可以触发氧气债务的影响,而不会产生较长间歇的高强度疲劳。
骑手经常使用这种锻炼,使他们进入顶级形式,其计算的平衡工作和休息在间歇期间。

Name: 4min Best effort!
Description:
As the name suggests, Maximal Aerobic intervals are high-intensity efforts where the majority (not all) of the power produced comes from aerobic energy pathways. Generally, athletes who excel in this area can climb and Time Trial well. 

On its own, Max Aerobic interval training is an effective method to increase fitness. However, Max Aerobic power is also a good indication of an athlete's potential. 

In today's session, we focus on 4min Max Aerobic efforts. You will be guided through the early intervals before completing a 4min 'best effort' to complete the set.
ChineseDescription:
顾名思义,最大有氧间歇是高强度的训练段,其中产生的大多数(不是全部)功率来自有氧能量通路。
一般来说,在这个领域擅长的运动员可以攀登和计时赛很好。
就其本身而言,Max Aerobic间歇训练是增加健身的有效方法。
然而,Max 有氧功率也很好地表明了运动员的潜力。
在今天的训练上,我们专注于4min Max 有氧运动。
您将在完成4分钟的“最佳训练段”之前通过早期间歇进行指导。

In today's session, we focus on 4min Max Aerobic efforts. You will be guided through the early intervals before completing a 4min 'best effort' to complete the set.

Name: 4min FTP #1
Description: Improving your FTP allows you to ride faster and more efficiently. By targeting shorter FTP efforts of 4min @ Threshold with 90sec recovery, athletes can focus and remain engaged in their training.
ChineseDescription:
改进您的FTP允许您更快,更高效地骑行。
通过将 90 秒恢复的 4min @ Threshold 的较短 FTP 工作目标为目标,运动员可以专注于并继续参与他们的训练。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Improving your FTP allows you to ride faster and more efficiently. By targeting shorter FTP efforts of 4min @ Threshold with 90sec recovery, athletes can focus and remain engaged in their training.

Name: 4min FTP #1
Description:
Improving your FTP allows you to ride faster and more efficiently. However, not all FTP work needs to focus on long intervals of over 20 minutes. 

By targeting shorter FTP efforts of 6 x 4min @ Threshold with 90sec recovery, athletes can focus and remain engaged in their training. The shorter intervals also allow you to analyse changes to your heart rate, cadence and power from each effort. The brief recovery period is enough to allow you to accumulate a good volume of quality work at threshold power. Yet, the fatigue will gradually build throughout the set intervals. 

Complete 30 minutes of zone 2 after your threshold work to build endurance.
ChineseDescription:
改进您的FTP允许您更快,更高效地骑行。
然而,并非所有的FTP工作都需要专注于超过20分钟的长间歇。
通过针对6 x 4min @ Threshold和90秒恢复的较短的FTP工作,运动员可以专注于并继续参与他们的训练。
更短的间歇还允许您分析每次训练段的心率,踏频和功率的变化。
短暂的恢复期足以让您在阈值功率下积累良好的质量工作量。
然而,疲劳将在整个设定的间歇中逐渐形成。
在阈值工作后完成第2区30分钟,以建立耐力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Improving your FTP allows you to ride faster and more efficiently. However, not all FTP work needs to focus on long intervals of over 20 minutes. 

By targeting shorter FTP efforts of 6 x 4min @ Threshold with 90sec recovery, athletes can focus and remain engaged in their training. The shorter intervals also allow you to analyse changes to your heart rate, cadence and power from each effort. The brief recovery period is enough to allow you to accumulate a good volume of quality work at threshold power. Yet, the fatigue will gradually build throughout the set intervals. 

Complete 30 minutes of zone 2 after your threshold work to build endurance.

Name: 5 minute strength #1
Description:
It's time to increase the intensity while also working on strength! After a good warm-up and 5-minutes of activation, the target power progressively increases. Throughout each effort, there is a progression of cadence and intensity. 

We begin with 80% of FTP power and finish the 5-minute effort at FTP power, while cadence will increase from 50 rpm to 100rpm. After three repetitions, it is time to do another activation at high cadence before a good cool down. 

Remember to drink; as the intensity goes up, you'll be sweating a lot!

是时候增加强度,同时也训练段的功率!
经过良好的热身和5分钟的激活后,目标功率逐渐增加。
在每个训练段中,都有踏频和强度的进展。
我们从 80% 的 FTP 功率开始,在 FTP 功率下完成 5 分钟的训练段,而踏频将从 50 rpm 增加到 100rpm。
经过三次重复,现在是时候在高踏频下进行另一次激活,然后进行良好的冷却。
记得喝;随着强度的提高,你会出汗很多!

Name: 5min 30/30's
Description:
This type of training is a very effective method to improve your VO2max abilities while also focusing on high rpm pedalling. By performing short, mild intensity efforts with brief recovery, we can trigger the effects of oxygen debt without the high levels of fatigue that come with longer intervals. 

Riders often use this workout to bring them into top form, with its calculated balance of work and rest during the interval period.
ChineseDescription:
这种类型的训练是一种非常有效的方法来提高您的VO2max能力,同时也专注于高转速踏板。
通过执行短,轻度的强度训练段和短暂的恢复,我们可以触发氧气债务的影响,而不会产生较长间歇的高强度疲劳。
骑手经常使用这种锻炼,使他们进入顶级形式,其计算的平衡工作和休息在间歇期间。

Name: 6min 30/30's
Description:
This type of training is a very effective method to improve your VO2max abilities while also focusing on high rpm pedalling. By performing short, mild intensity efforts with brief recovery, we can trigger the effects of oxygen debt without the high levels of fatigue that come with longer intervals. 

Riders often use this workout to bring them into top form, with its calculated balance of work and rest during the interval period.
ChineseDescription:
这种类型的训练是一种非常有效的方法来提高您的VO2max能力,同时也专注于高转速踏板。
通过执行短,轻度的强度训练段和短暂的恢复,我们可以触发氧气债务的影响,而不会产生较长间歇的高强度疲劳。
骑手经常使用这种锻炼,使他们进入顶级形式,其计算的平衡工作和休息在间歇期间。

Name: 7min 30/30's
Description: We continue progressing into higher intensity in the form of intermittent training by increasing the amount of 30-second reps up to 7 in each set. We also raise the intensity at which we perform each 30-second micro interval, tapping into the reserve of anaerobic fuel and energy. This stimulates our body to increase the oxygen-carrying capacity, improving the efficiency of energy substrate use and enhancing acid buffering systems. The goal is to increase VO2max and, as a consequence, our FTP.
ChineseDescription:
我们继续以间歇性训练的形式发展到更高的强度,每组增加30秒代表的数量至7。
我们还提高了我们执行每30秒微间歇的强度,利用无氧燃料和能量的储备。
这刺激我们的身体,以增加携带氧气的能力,提高能源基板的使用效率,并增强酸缓冲系统。
我们的目标是增加VO2max,因此,我们的FTP。

Name: 8min 30/30's
Description:
Another session of intermittent training, performing 30/30s for an accumulated time of 12 min above threshold. 

After warming up, we complete three sets of 8-minute blocks of 30 seconds above FTP, followed by 30 seconds of recovery. The rest period mustn't be too easy to train the muscle fibres to use the lactate produced as a fuel.

另一节间歇训练,在超过阈值12分钟的累积时间内执行30/30秒。
热身后,我们完成了三组8分钟的块,比FTP高30秒,然后是30秒的恢复。
休息时间不能太容易训练肌肉纤维使用产生的乳酸作为燃料。

Name: 8min Rolling TT
Description:
Today's session consists of 2 x 8 minute rolling TT intervals. Rolling intervals are performed within Zone 4. However, each 8-minute interval is preceded by a 30 second Zone 5 effort. 

However, today aims to disrupt your rhythm by moving the target power up and down every minute.

然而,今天的目标是通过每分钟上下移动目标功率来破坏你的节奏。

Name: 90 Minute Endurance
Description:
Zone 2 endurance training is one of the most important aspects of any training plan. In this training Zone, we predominately stimulate Type 1 muscle fibres, leading to increased mitochondrial growth and function. You improve your ability to utilise fat as the preferred fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores. Long periods within Zone 2 will benefit any athlete. 

Feel free to substitute this structured endurance ride with a low-intensity free ride. Or jump into a low-intensity group ride if available. Choose a course or group ride that will allow you to spend most of your ride with Zone 2.
ChineseDescription:
2区耐力训练是任何训练计划中最重要的方面之一。
在这个训练区,我们主要刺激1型肌肉纤维,导致线粒体生长和功能增加。
您提高利用脂肪作为首选燃料来源的能力,并保留您宝贵的糖原存储。
2区内的长时间将有利于任何运动员。
随意用低强度的免费骑行来替代这种结构化的耐力骑行。
或者跳入低强度的团体骑行,如果可用。
选择一个课程或团体骑行,让您在2区花费大部分的骑行时间。

Description: The challenge today is to reach the target power with the highest cadence possible.

Name: A Steady Resolve
Description:
Longer upper-aerobic passages develop sustained pacing while keeping the work below Sweet Spot intensity. Easier passages help you maintain control across the session.

Today, we build around a twenty-minute upper-aerobic block, with a sustained opening and a shorter closing passage. Keep the effort even and resist pushing above the targets.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
以较长的高有氧区间培养持续配速能力，强度保持在甜点区以下。今天以20分钟的高有氧训练段为核心，前段较长、收尾较短。保持输出均匀，不要超过目标功率。

英文原文：

Today, we build around a twenty-minute upper-aerobic block, with a sustained opening and a shorter closing passage. Keep the effort even and resist pushing above the targets.

Name: AC + Sweetspot #1
Description: The aim today is to both work on your Anaerobic Capacity, and to also improve your aerobic efficiency. We do this by completing 5 x 2min AC intervals, before finishing with a 10min Sweetspot effort. By depleting your carbohydrate stores with the AC intervals, the 10min Sweetspot effort may not be as comfortable as it should be!
ChineseDescription:
今天的目标是既工作你的无氧能力,也提高你的有氧效率。
我们通过完成 5 x 2min 交流间歇来做到这一点,然后完成 10min Sweetspot 的训练段。
通过消耗你的碳水化合物储存与交流间歇,10min Sweetspot的训练段可能不会像它应该的那样舒适!

Name: Accelerations #2
Description:
Accelerating into corners and improving position is an essential factor in any race. But quite often, these accelerations occur from an already high, steady power. 

In this session, we replicate this demand by completing a series of sprints preceded by a steady-state effort.
ChineseDescription:
加速进入角落并改善位置是任何种族中必不可少的因素。
但很多时候,这些加速度来自已经很高的稳定功率。
在这次训练中,我们通过完成一系列冲刺来复制这一需求,然后进行稳定状态的训练段。

Description: Endurance sessions are the ideal time to focus on improving your pedalling.

耐力赛是专注于改善您的踏板的理想时间。

Name: Across the Contours
Description:
Rolling changes in aerobic effort can make a longer indoor ride engaging without requiring hard surges.

Today, we settle into a steady approach before riding three gentle rolls. Build smoothly, hold each crest, ease down and spend a little time in the valley before the next rise.
ChineseDescription:
有氧运动的滚动变化可以使更长的室内骑行参与,而无需硬浪涌。
今天,我们在骑三个温柔的辊之前安定下来。
建造顺利,保持每个顶峰,放松下来,在下一次上升之前在山谷中度过一点时间。

Name: Aerobic 12's #1
Description:
The primary goal of endurance training is to improve your ability to preserve glycogen. The more efficient you are in your fuel source, the more energy you will have for the finale. 

Aerobic Endurance workouts are aimed at improving your efficiency at lower intensity levels. You are training your muscles to access fat as its primary fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores for the finale. 

After warming up, you will be completing 3 x 12min aerobic efforts with 3min recovery.
ChineseDescription:
耐力训练的主要目标是提高你保存糖原的能力。
你在你的燃料源中效率越高,你将有越多的能量用于结局。
有氧耐力锻炼的目的是提高你的效率在较低的强度水平。
您正在训练您的肌肉以获取脂肪作为主要燃料来源,并保留您宝贵的糖原储存以供结局。
热身后,您将完成3 x 12min的有氧训练段,3min的恢复。

Description:
Increasing your anaerobic capacity will help you become a stronger cyclist. Anaerobic energy can be used for a short burst at a higher power output than your FTP. 

To improve your anaerobic capacity, we need to produce high power efforts between 30sec and 3min. This session replicates AC intervals performed on a climb by adding a target rpm. 

The climb starts steady enough before stepping up to the finish with high power.

此训练通过添加目标 rpm 来复制在攀爬过程中执行的交流间歇。
攀登开始足够稳定,然后以高功率加速到终点。

The workout concludes with a 6min VO2 effort featuring the same steady increase in target power.

Name: Champs-Elysees
Description:
Perhaps the most famous road for any sprinter, the Champs-Elysees, indeed the most coveted victory you could have as a sprinter. Winning the final stage of the Tour de France, in Paris, on this famous 1.9Km section of the cobbled avenue. 

As we head into the preparation phase of this Sprint Focussed Programme, we simulate the final stage of the Tour de France with a series of strenuous efforts, culminating in a sprint for the win!
ChineseDescription:
也许是任何冲刺型车手最著名的道路,香榭丽舍大街,事实上,作为冲刺型车手,你可以拥有的最令人垂涎的胜利。
赢得巴黎环法自行车赛的最后阶段,在这个著名的1.9公里段的鹅卵石大道上。
当我们进入这个Sprint焦点计划的准备阶段时,我们通过一系列艰苦的训练段模拟了环法自行车赛的最后阶段,最终以冲刺获胜!

Name: Change of Pace
Description: Short changes in pace can add variety to an aerobic workout without turning it into a high-intensity session. The key is to lift the effort briefly before settling comfortably back into your aerobic rhythm. Today, we ride at a steady aerobic intensity with two short increases in effort along the way. Keep the lifts controlled, then smoothly settle back into your regular pace.
ChineseDescription:
节奏的短暂变化可以增加有氧运动的多样性,而不会将其变成高强度的训练。
关键是要在舒适地回到你的有氧节奏之前短暂地放松一下。
今天,我们以稳定的有氧强度骑行,沿途有两个短暂的增加。
保持升降机的控制,然后顺利地回到你的正常节奏。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Short changes in pace can add variety to an aerobic workout without turning it into a high-intensity session. The key is to lift the effort briefly before settling comfortably back into your aerobic rhythm. Today, we ride at a steady aerobic intensity with two short increases in effort along the way. Keep the lifts controlled, then smoothly settle back into your regular pace.

Name: Changing Landscapes
Description:
Different aerobic levels and block lengths can provide useful milestones without turning a ride into hard interval training. The aim is to settle into each level rather than accelerate sharply between them.

Today, we move through an uneven aerobic circuit with two controlled crests and a gradual settling finish. Keep the changes smooth and enjoy the changing rhythm.
ChineseDescription:
不同的有氧水平和块长度可以提供有用的里程碑,而不会将骑行变成艰苦的间歇训练。
目标是进入每个层次,而不是在它们之间急剧加速。
今天,我们通过一个不均匀的有氧回路,有两个受控的顶峰和一个逐渐沉降完成。
保持变化平稳,享受变化的节奏。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Different aerobic levels and block lengths can provide useful milestones without turning a ride into hard interval training. The aim is to settle into each level rather than accelerate sharply between them.

Today, we move through an uneven aerobic circuit with two controlled crests and a gradual settling finish. Keep the changes smooth and enjoy the changing rhythm.

Name: Classic and Cruel Russian Steps by Si Bradeley
Description:
One of the most effective interval formats ever created. Russian Steps gradually increase the duration of each effort before working back down the ladder, repeatedly pushing you above threshold while challenging your ability to recover quickly.  
Three full pyramids put the focus on VO₂ development, threshold power and repeatability — but the constantly changing effort and recovery durations make this as much a test of concentration and resilience as fitness.
ChineseName: 经典和残酷的俄罗斯步骤 Si Bradeley
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
俄罗斯阶梯间歇先逐步延长每次发力时间，再逐级缩短，反复突破阈值并考验快速恢复能力。完成3个完整金字塔，重点发展最大摄氧量、阈值功率和重复输出能力；不断变化的发力与恢复时长也考验专注力和韧性。

英文原文：
One of the most effective interval formats ever created. Russian Steps gradually increase the duration of each effort before working back down the ladder, repeatedly pushing you above threshold while challenging your ability to recover quickly.  
Three full pyramids put the focus on VO₂ development, threshold power and repeatability — but the constantly changing effort and recovery durations make this as much a test of concentration and resilience as fitness.

Name: Climbing into sprints
Description:

Position yourself on the bike as you would on a long climb. The Tempo interval finishes with 2 x 15-second near-maximal sprints over the top of the climb.

时间间歇在攀登顶部以2 x 15秒的近乎最大冲刺结束。

Name: Crank Torque
Description: When we complete long climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which in turn recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. With this in mind, it's important that our training meets the demands of the event. Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near threshold finale!

考虑到这一点,我们的培训必须满足活动的要求。
今天,我们正在执行较低的踏频间歇,但功率更接近阈值。
加热后,训练由4个间歇组成,踏频从70rpm到95rpm不等。
所有这一切都让你准备好高踏频,接近阈值结局!

With this in mind, it's important that our training meets the demands of the event. Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near threshold finale!

Name: Day off
Description: Take a well-deserved rest day today. There will be the odd occasion where your coach is going to enforce a day off the bike. This is a good opportunity to check your bike over and ensure it is also ready for race day.

Name: Depleting 20's
Description:
After completing a good warmup, the session is focused on two areas. Completing 2 x 10min Sub-threshold intervals, and 8 x 20sec accelerations. 

However, with the 20sec accelerations coming after the first 10min Sub-threshold interval, we aim to deplete your intramuscular glycogen stores and see what effect this has on the second 10min interval. 

Is the second 10min interval as comfortable as the first?
ChineseDescription:
在完成良好的热身后,训练侧重于两个方面。
完成 2 x 10min 子阈值间歇和 8 x 20sec 加速度。
然而,随着20秒加速在第一个10分钟亚阈值间歇之后到来,我们的目标是耗尽你的肌肉内糖原存储,看看这对第二个10分钟间歇有什么影响。
第二个10分钟的间歇是否和第一个一样舒适?

Name: Depleting Session #1
Description: Large amounts of tempo work in today's session, but the focus here is on fuel. To produce zone 3 power and above requires a significant amount of glycogen. But what happens when this fuel source has been depleted? In today's workout we begin with a steady-state zone 3 effort, followed by a series of bottom end, zone 4 intervals. All of this is followed by the same opening zone 3 interval. Take note and compare your sensations and heart rate response in the two steady-state tempo efforts. Is the final tempo effort as comfortable as the first?
ChineseDescription:
在今天的训练上,大量的节奏工作,但这里的重点是燃料。
要产生区域3功率及以上需要大量的糖原。
但是,当燃料来源耗尽时会发生什么?
在今天的锻炼中,我们从稳态区域3训练段开始,然后是一系列底端,区域4间歇。
所有这一切后面跟着相同的开区 3 间歇。
注意并比较您在两种稳定状态速度训练段中的感觉和心率反应。
最后的节奏是否和第一次一样舒适?

Name: Dummy File - Needs to be Deleted
Description: Use today in a way that best suits your needs. Take a well-deserved rest day, or if looking to increase your weekly volume, today is the perfect day to achieve this. Your focus each week should first be on completing the set interval workouts. However, if you have the time available to increase your weekly volume, then Zone 2 endurance riding will complement your training plan. Long periods within Zone 2 will benefit any athlete. In this training Zone, we predominately stimulate Type 1 muscle fibres, leading to increased mitochondrial growth and function. You improve your ability to utilise fat as the preferred fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores with endurance training. To achieve this riding time within Zone 2, options include joining a low-intensity group ride, or performing a free-ride over a predominately flat course.

今天可根据自身情况休息，或通过第2区耐力骑行增加每周训练量。每周应优先完成计划中的间歇课程；若有时间，再补充耐力训练。第2区训练主要刺激I型慢肌纤维，有助于线粒体生长及功能，改善脂肪供能并节约糖原。可以选择低强度团骑，或在以平路为主的路线自由骑行。

You improve your ability to utilise fat as the preferred fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores with endurance training. To achieve this riding time within Zone 2, options include joining a low-intensity group ride, or performing a free-ride over a predominately flat course.

Name: Easy Does It
Description: Low-intensity aerobic riding is a simple and effective way to build your aerobic fitness without placing too much stress on the body. These easier sessions can also be useful when you want to keep training while managing fatigue. Today, we keep things simple with a steady aerobic effort. Settle into a comfortable rhythm, keep your effort controlled and focus on smooth, consistent riding throughout.

当您想要在管理疲劳的同时保持训练时,这些更容易的训练也非常有用。
今天,我们通过稳定的有氧训练段保持简单。
适应舒适的节奏,保持你的训练段控制,并专注于平稳,一致的骑行。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Low-intensity aerobic riding is a simple and effective way to build your aerobic fitness without placing too much stress on the body. These easier sessions can also be useful when you want to keep training while managing fatigue. Today, we keep things simple with a steady aerobic effort. Settle into a comfortable rhythm, keep your effort controlled and focus on smooth, consistent riding throughout.

Name: Endurance #2
Description: Long, low-intensity efforts aren't the only method to build endurance. By incorporating short surges into a steady effort, you will increase your oxygen uptake and training stimulus. Completing a low-intensity effort with a surge every 4 minutes should feel comfortable, but the constant change in power and surging will provide you with significant gains in endurance.

长时间、低强度的训练段并不是建立耐力的唯一方法。
通过将短浪涌纳入稳定的训练段,您将增加您的氧气吸收和训练刺激。
完成低强度的训练段每4分钟激增应该感到舒适,但功率的不断变化和飙升将为您提供显着的耐力增益。

Completing a low-intensity effort with a surge every 4 minutes should feel comfortable, but the constant change in power and surging will provide you with significant gains in endurance.

Name: Endurance + 10min Best Effort
Description:
Producing peak power late in the race is a critical element of performance. 

After warming up, the workout provides you with a block of free-riding where the aim is to ride within zones 2 to 3. This period of riding serves to build fatigue and deplete vital glycogen stores. 

The session is then completed with a 10 minute 'best effort'. The aim is for this effort to be close to your FTP power.
ChineseDescription:
在比赛后期产生峰值功率是性能的关键因素。
热身后,锻炼为您提供了一个免费骑行块,目标是在2至3区内骑行。
这一时期的骑行有助于建立疲劳和消耗重要的糖原存储。
然后,训练以10分钟的“最佳训练段”完成。
目的是使这项工作接近您的FTP电源。

Name: Endurance 12's #1
Description:
The primary goal of endurance training is to improve your ability to preserve glycogen. The more efficient you are in your fuel source, the more energy you will have for the finale. 

Aerobic Endurance workouts are aimed at improving your efficiency at lower intensity levels. You are training your muscles to access fat as its primary fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores for the finale. 

After warming up, you will be completing 3 x 12min aerobic efforts with 3min recovery.
ChineseDescription:
耐力训练的主要目标是提高你保存糖原的能力。
你在你的燃料源中效率越高,你将有越多的能量用于结局。
有氧耐力锻炼的目的是提高你的效率在较低的强度水平。
您正在训练您的肌肉以获取脂肪作为主要燃料来源,并保留您宝贵的糖原储存以供结局。
热身后,您将完成3 x 12min的有氧训练段,3min的恢复。

Name: Endurance with 30 Max"
Description: This session will help improve your pedalling efficiency and increase your cardiovascular capacity. Introducing the body to some sprint focussed efforts. Including 30 second maximal efforts within an endurance ride will prolong the training effect into the future. As well as give you an opportunity to put into practice a lot of the sprint technique stuff we have been working on. Carry out 3 x 10 minute blocks of alternating high/low cadence. At the end of each block, finish with a 30 second maximal effort.

这些都是艰苦的训练段!
电源将在前10秒达到峰值,然后下降。
这是从一开始就最大的训练段。

Name: Escalating 3min VO2max
Description:
There's no escaping the fact that VO2max intervals are hard work. However, with the right amount of VO2max work, there are significant gains in your ability to sustain high power. 

VO2max is the amount of oxygen your body can use at a sustained maximal output. The more oxygen your body can absorb, the more power you produce. 

In today's session, we are focussing on 3min VO2max efforts. However, we will escalate the intensity of each interval, starting with 'hard' and finishing with 'hardest'!
ChineseDescription:
毫无疑问,VO2max间歇是艰苦的工作。
然而,有了适量的VO2max工作,你维持高功率的能力会显著提高。
VO2max是你的身体在持续的最大输出下可以使用的氧气量。
你的身体吸收的氧气越多,你产生的能量就越多。
在今天的训练上,我们专注于3min VO2max的训练段。
然而,我们将升级每个间歇的强度,从“硬”开始,以“最硬”结束!

In today's session, we are focussing on 3min VO2max efforts. However, we will escalate the intensity of each interval, starting with 'hard' and finishing with 'hardest'!

Name: Explosive Endurance 12's
Description:

无氧工作涉及高踏频和显著的功率,以及抵抗疲劳的能力。
虽然训练段很短暂,但我们正在寻找稳定的功率输送,没有下降。
有足够的恢复时间,这些都是今天的质量间歇。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Fat for Fuel
Description: This low-intensity session is designed to improve your ability to utilise fat as a fuel source. Riding at low powers uses fat oxidation more than carbohydrates. Although we recommend care to be taken with your nutrition, it is possible to do this session fasted. However, consume a meal immediately after the session and continue your daily dietary routine. IMPORTANT: This is not a session to lose weight but to improve your body's capability to use fat as a fuel source.
ChineseDescription:
这个低强度的训练旨在提高你利用脂肪作为燃料来源的能力。
低功率骑马比碳水化合物使用脂肪氧化。
虽然我们建议小心对待你的营养,这是有可能做这个训练禁食。
但是,在训练结束后立即进食,并继续您的日常饮食习惯。
重要:这不是一个减肥的训练,而是提高你的身体使用脂肪作为燃料来源的能力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Although we recommend care to be taken with your nutrition, it is possible to do this session fasted. However, consume a meal immediately after the session and continue your daily dietary routine. IMPORTANT: This is not a session to lose weight but to improve your body's capability to use fat as a fuel source.

Name: Fatigued Sprints
Description:
There are two purposes of today's tough session. The first is a fatigued sprint, including a series of intervals designed to load your legs and work your sustainable powers, but ultimately, to soften you up for what is to come. The second is a double sprint, simulating a more true sprint scenario. 

You will often need to sprint to fight for a position before launching your race-winning move. Enjoy!
ChineseDescription:
今天的艰难训练有两个目的。
第一个是疲劳的冲刺,包括一系列旨在加载你的腿和工作你的可持续能力的间歇,但最终,软化你即将到来的事情。
第二个是双冲刺,模拟更真实的冲刺场景。
您经常需要冲刺来争取一个位置,然后启动您的比赛获胜的举动。
享受吧!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

The second is a double sprint, simulating a more true sprint scenario. 

You will often need to sprint to fight for a position before launching your race-winning move. Enjoy!

Name: Finding Your Flow
Description:
Comfortable aerobic riding provides time to practise a relaxed, sustainable rhythm. A gentle build adds direction without making the whole ride harder.

Today, we settle into an easy rhythm, gradually build the effort, then finish with a long, even aerobic passage.
ChineseDescription:
舒适的有氧骑行提供了时间来练习放松,可持续的节奏。
温和的构建增加了方向,而不会使整个骑行更加困难。
今天,我们安顿成一个简单的节奏,逐渐建立训练段,然后用长,甚至有氧通道完成。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Today, we settle into an easy rhythm, gradually build the effort, then finish with a long, even aerobic passage.

Name: Fresh Perspective
Description:
Gradual aerobic builds encourage smooth pacing, while a short easier section provides a chance to relax and reset your rhythm.

Today, we ride two gentle builds separated by five comfortable minutes. Let the effort rise gradually, then use the easier section to settle before building again.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
渐进提高有氧强度，练习平顺配速。今天完成两段温和递增的训练，中间轻松骑行5分钟。逐步增加输出，利用较轻松的中段调整节奏，再开始第二次递增。

英文原文：
Gradual aerobic builds encourage smooth pacing, while a short easier section provides a chance to relax and reset your rhythm.

Today, we ride two gentle builds separated by five comfortable minutes. Let the effort rise gradually, then use the easier section to settle before building again.

Name: FTP Test - MyWhoosh
Description:
Welcome to the MyWhoosh 20min FTP test! 

Regular testing is essential to maintain accurate training zones and evaluate your training response. It requires maximal focus and effort from you to ensure you are capturing a precise measure of your current fitness. 

Today's workout will take you through a long warmup before completing a high-intensity 5min 'primer' effort, followed by the 20min test effort. Once you have completed the workout, you will be notified of any changes to your current FTP. 

NOTE: ERG mode MUST be on. It will automatically turn off for free-ride intervals.
ChineseDescription:
欢迎来到MyWoosh 20min FTP测试!
定期测试对于保持准确的培训区域和评估您的培训响应至关重要。
它需要你最大的专注和训练段,以确保你捕捉到你当前的健康状况的精确度量。
今天的锻炼将带你经过长时间的热身,然后完成高强度的5分钟“初级”训练段,然后进行20分钟的测试。
一旦你完成了锻炼,你会收到任何改变你当前FTP的通知。
注意:ERG模式必须开启。
它将自动关闭自由骑行间歇。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Regular testing is essential to maintain accurate training zones and evaluate your training response. It requires maximal focus and effort from you to ensure you are capturing a precise measure of your current fitness.

NOTE: ERG mode MUST be on. It will automatically turn off for free-ride intervals.

Name: Grinding Halt

ChineseDescription:
这个练习将带您通过比赛模拟。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Description: Early threshold work finished off with Max Aerobic efforts, which makes for an interesting session!
ChineseDescription:
早期的阈值工作完成了Max Aerobic的训练段,这使得一个有趣的训练!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Hard Starts #1
Description:
Another threshold focused session that adds an element of race specificity to it. The main set of intervals consists of 7min descending threshold efforts preceded by a high-intensity 30sec effort. 

This session closely reflects the demands you will face in a criterium race, with a challenging start or surge at the beginning of a long, sustained effort.
ChineseDescription:
另一个以阈值为重点的训练,为它添加了种族特异性的元素。
主要的间歇包括7分钟下降阈值的训练段,之前的高强度30秒的训练段。
这次训练密切反映了你在一场激烈的竞争中将面临的需求,在长期持续训练段的开始或激增。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Another threshold focused session that adds an element of race specificity to it. The main set of intervals consists of 7min descending threshold efforts preceded by a high-intensity 30sec effort. 

This session closely reflects the demands you will face in a criterium race, with a challenging start or surge at the beginning of a long, sustained effort.

Name: Hard Starts #2
Description:
Another session that adds an element of race specificity with high-intensity efforts. The main set of intervals consists of repeated anaerobic efforts, followed by a sustained period at and above threshold. 

Much like a road race, you will be required to produce high power with slight recovery.
ChineseDescription:
另一场训练通过高强度的训练段增加了种族特异性因素。
主要的一系列间歇包括反复的无氧训练段,然后是在阈值和阈值以上的持续周期。
就像一场公路赛一样,您将被要求在轻微恢复的情况下产生高功率。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Another session that adds an element of race specificity with high-intensity efforts. The main set of intervals consists of repeated anaerobic efforts, followed by a sustained period at and above threshold. 

Much like a road race, you will be required to produce high power with slight recovery.

ChineseDescription:
这些受控的 30/30 工作是在低于您的最大有氧功率 (MAP) 的功率下完成的。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: High Intensity 5min
Description: High intensity efforts focusing on the ability to produce anaerobic power, from an already threshold power. The intervals simulate the demands of flat, fast efforts, as well as climbing efforts with a lower cadence.
ChineseDescription:
高强度的训练段集中在产生无氧功率的能力,从已经阈值的功率。
这些间歇模拟了平坦,快速的训练段以及以较低的踏频攀登训练段的需求。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: High Intensity 5min
Description:
High-intensity efforts focus on the ability to produce anaerobic power from an already threshold power. 

The intervals simulate the demands of flat, fast efforts and climbing efforts with a lower cadence.
ChineseDescription:
高强度的工作重点是从已经达到的临界功率产生无氧功率的能力。
这些间歇模拟了以较低的踏频进行平坦、快速的训练段和攀登的训练段的需求。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

The intervals simulate the demands of flat, fast efforts and climbing efforts with a lower cadence.

Name: High Torque Hills #1
Description:
When we complete long climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. With this in mind, it's vital that our training meets the demands of the event. 

Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. 

All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near-threshold finale!
ChineseDescription:
当我们完成长爬坡时,较低的踏频会导致高曲柄扭矩,从而吸引更多的快肌纤维。
考虑到这一点,我们的培训必须满足活动的要求。
今天,我们正在执行较低的踏频间歇,但功率更接近阈值。
加热后,训练由4个间歇组成,踏频从70rpm到95rpm不等。
所有这一切都让你准备好高踏频,接近阈值的结局!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
When we complete long climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. With this in mind, it's vital that our training meets the demands of the event. 

Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. 

All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near-threshold finale!

Name: High Torque Hills #2
Description:
Not every course is composed of long gentle climbs. Sometimes a course consists of rolling, punchy climbs that require significant changes in cadence and power. 

Generally, the 1st effort is comfortable. But come the 4th and 5th effort, the legs have fatigued. Today we train for the demands of these repeated rolling hills.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
路线不总是平缓长坡，也可能由需要大幅改变踏频和功率的短陡起伏组成。第1次爬坡通常比较轻松，到第4、5次时双腿已积累疲劳。本课针对反复起伏爬坡的需求进行训练。

英文原文：
Not every course is composed of long gentle climbs. Sometimes a course consists of rolling, punchy climbs that require significant changes in cadence and power. 

Generally, the 1st effort is comfortable. But come the 4th and 5th effort, the legs have fatigued. Today we train for the demands of these repeated rolling hills.

Name: High Torque Hills #3
Description:
Quite often, climbing is characterised by a low cadence and a high force production, increasing crank torque. This high crank torque puts specific demands on the muscles and neuromuscular recruitment. 

We hit this area by completing three sets of 3min efforts at a low rpm in this session.
ChineseDescription:
通常情况下,攀岩的特点是低踏频和高力生产,增加曲柄扭矩。
这种高曲柄扭矩对肌肉和神经肌肉招募提出了具体要求。
我们通过在本届训练的低转速下完成三组3分钟的训练段来达到这个领域。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

We hit this area by completing three sets of 3min efforts at a low rpm in this session.

Name: Higher and Faster
Description:
Racing often requires you to fight for position before exploding out of the corners. This effort requires sustained power before accelerating well above threshold. 

Over a flat course, you will have to perform these accelerations at a high cadence, adding another element to your performance.
ChineseDescription:
赛车通常要求你在从角落爆炸之前为位置而战。
这种训练段需要持续的功率,才能加速远高于阈值。
在平坦的课程中,您必须以高踏频执行这些加速,为您的性能添加另一个元素。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Racing often requires you to fight for position before exploding out of the corners. This effort requires sustained power before accelerating well above threshold. 

Over a flat course, you will have to perform these accelerations at a high cadence, adding another element to your performance.

Name: HIIT 45sec #1
Description:
With repeated anaerobic bouts of 45sec, you will be improving your ability to process lactate and recover from strenuous efforts. You will also use up vital carbohydrate stores before the final 5min sub-threshold interval. 

This is where the adaptation occurs!
ChineseDescription:
随着45秒的反复无氧回合,您将提高处理乳酸并从艰苦的训练段中恢复的能力。
您还将在最后的5分钟亚阈值间歇之前消耗重要的碳水化合物储存。
这就是适应发生的地方!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: HIIT 45sec #2
Description:
Building upon your previous HIIT 45sec session, this time, we are extending the final sub-threshold interval to 8min. The same principles apply. The HIIT intervals use up vital carbohydrate stores before the last 8min sub-threshold effort. 

This is where the adaptation occurs!
ChineseDescription:
基于您之前的HIIT 45sec训练,这次我们将最终的子阈值间歇延长至8分钟。
同样的原则也适用。
HIIT间歇在最后8分钟亚阈值训练段之前消耗了重要的碳水化合物储存。
这就是适应发生的地方!

Name: Hill Climb
Description: This group workout takes you through another race simulation. Taking you through a short, sharp stage with an uphill start! Follow along as you go through a similar warm-up to the pro's - Then hit the stage hard as we climb right from the gun.

Name: Hill Reps
Description: Remain seated whilst completing the climbing efforts. We don't want to stress the heart rate too much during the effort, rather, letting the legs do the majority of the work. When climbing in the real world, it is good practice to start steady and ramp up the effort as you come to crest the climb. In reality, it is easy to hit the climb too hard! This is good session to condition you to riding climbs smartly and effectively.

我们不想在训练段过程中过度强调心率,而是让腿做大部分工作。
当在现实世界中攀登时,当你攀登攀登时,开始稳定并增加训练段是很好的练习。
实际上,很容易撞到爬坡太难了!
这是很好的训练,以条件你骑聪明而有效地攀登。

Name: Hills #1
Description:
We often hit a small hill with some speed when racing but soon lose this momentum. This results in the need to produce more power at a lower rpm. 

Today's session prepares us for such a scenario. Picture yourself hitting the hill with speed and then grinding over the top.
ChineseDescription:
我们经常在比赛时以某种速度撞上小山,但很快就失去了这种势头。
这导致需要在较低的转速下产生更多的功率。
今天的训练为我们准备了这样一种情况。
想象一下自己以速度撞上山,然后碾过顶部。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Hold the Horizon
Description:
Sustained aerobic blocks give you time to establish a steady rhythm and practise controlled pacing over longer efforts.

Today, we ride two stronger aerobic blocks separated by an easier reset. The second block is longer but slightly gentler, so aim for consistency rather than chasing intensity.
ChineseDescription:
持续的有氧块让您有时间建立稳定的节奏,并在较长的训练段中练习受控的配速。
今天,我们骑两个更强的有氧块通过更容易重置分开。
第二个块更长,但稍微温和一点,所以目标是一致性,而不是追逐强度。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Sustained aerobic blocks give you time to establish a steady rhythm and practise controlled pacing over longer efforts.

Today, we ride two stronger aerobic blocks separated by an easier reset. The second block is longer but slightly gentler, so aim for consistency rather than chasing intensity.

Name: I can change
Description: Today we simulate a race situation with multiple short climbs. Today is the day to push yourself and show us what you have got!
ChineseDescription:

今天是推自己,并告诉我们你有什么!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Increasing Anaerobic Capacity
Description:
This is a very high level of intensity that requires mental and physical perseverance. It is essential to increase your ability to produce short, high powered efforts, but so too is the importance of being able to repeat these efforts with slight recovery. 

In today's session, the efforts get shorter, but the power increases.
ChineseDescription:
这是一个非常高的强度水平,需要精神和身体的毅力。
重要的是要提高你的能力,以产生短,高功率的训练段,但能够重复这些训练段与轻微恢复的重要性也是如此。
在今天的训练上,训练段变得更短,但功率却在增加。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Intensive Aerobic
Description:
The upper region of Aerobic training can be pretty demanding. Today's session begins with the longest and hardest effort before the intervals reduce duration and intensity. 

But will your legs recover enough before the next effort to feel the decline in workload?
ChineseDescription:
有氧训练的上部区域可能非常苛刻。
今天的训练以间歇减少持续时间和强度之前最长和最难的训练段开始。
但是,在下一次训练段感受工作量下降之前,你的腿会恢复足够的吗?

There's no getting away from the benefits of long aerobic efforts. This Intensive Aerobic duration is the point where most of the energy comes from aerobic pathways.

Name: Intensive Pmax into Tempo #1
Description: After warming up complete 2 sets of Intensive Pmax work. The first set consists of 4 x 20sec efforts with a recovery period of 2 minutes in Zone 2. The second set consists of 6 x 15 second efforts performed throughout a tempo effort. The accelerations are shorter in the 2nd set, but with the pressure kept on the pedals during the recovery period, this will challenge your ability to recover.

Name: Intermittent 30/15's #1
Description:
After warming up, the session will focus on completing a series of intermittent style intervals. This type of training is ideal for maximizing adaptations to Max Aerobic fitness. 

Intermittent intervals allow you to complete a more significant amount of work at your Max Aerobic intensity than continuous intervals would allow. 

The main set consists of completing 5 x 30/15s.

间歇性间歇允许您以最大有氧强度完成比连续间歇允许的更显著的工作量。
主集包括完成5 x 30 / 15s。

Name: Intervals - What are they?
Description: In cycling, we use the word 'Intervals' to define periods of higher intensity work alternating with low-intensity periods of recovery. Intervals play an essential part in your training. They increase fitness and allow you to burn more calories over a shorter period than steady-state riding. Today we look at different ways of completing interval workouts and why we need them.
ChineseDescription:
在循环中,我们使用“间歇”一词来定义高强度工作与低强度恢复周期交替的时期。
间歇在你的训练中起着至关重要的作用。
它们可以增加健身量,并允许您在比稳定状态骑行更短的时间内燃烧更多的卡路里。
今天,我们来看看完成间歇锻炼的不同方法以及为什么我们需要它们。

它们可以增加健身量,并允许您在比稳定状态骑行更短的时间内燃烧更多的卡路里。
在循环中,我们使用“间歇”一词来定义高强度工作与低强度恢复周期交替的时期。
今天,我们来看看完成间歇锻炼的不同方法以及为什么我们需要它们。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Intervals play an essential part in your training. They increase fitness and allow you to burn more calories over a shorter period than steady-state riding. In cycling, we use the word 'Intervals' to define periods of higher intensity work alternating with low-intensity periods of recovery. 

Today we look at different ways of completing interval workouts and why we need them.

Name: Into the Red!
Description:
Now that you have gained some experience with interval training, you're ready to hit the high-intensity efforts. These are high intensity, hard intervals that require some concentration. These Zone 6, or Anaerobic Capacity intervals are generally 30sec to 3min in duration. 

Zone 6 intervals are generally completed in 'sets'. A set is a group of consecutive intervals. You have another ' set' when you have a long recovery before beginning more successive intervals.
ChineseDescription:
现在你已经获得了一些间歇训练的经验,你已经准备好进行高强度训练了。
这些是高强度的,硬的间歇,需要一定的浓度。
这些区域6或无氧容量间歇通常为30秒至3分钟。
区域6的间歇通常在“集合”中完成。
集合是一组连续的间歇。
当你在开始更多连续的间歇之前有很长的恢复时,你有另一个“设置”。

Name: Jangling Jack
Description: This session will help improve your endurance capacity and peak power efforts.
ChineseDescription:
这次训练将有助于提高你的耐力能力和峰值功率的训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This session will help improve your endurance capacity and peak power efforts.

Name: Just a normal day
Description: With a short recovery between intervals, today, we are replicating the demands of high-speed performance.
ChineseDescription:
由于间歇时间短,今天,我们正在复制高速性能的要求。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
With a short recovery between intervals, today, we are replicating the demands of high-speed performance.

Name: Keep talking
Description: This is a climbing simulation session, but with a focus on working your ability to sustain your threshold powers.
ChineseDescription:
这是一个攀爬模拟训练,但重点是工作你的能力,以维持你的阈值能力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This is a climbing simulation session, but with a focus on working your ability to sustain your threshold powers.

Name: Lactate Clearance
Description: After completing a good warmup, today we have four repetitions of the following cycle: 30sec  all-out followed by a 90sec at a brisk pace below FTP but still hard enough that it will stress the aerobic system to use lactate produced.
ChineseDescription:
在完成一个好的热身后,今天我们有四个重复的以下周期:30秒全输出,然后是90秒以低于FTP的快节奏,但仍然足够硬,它将强调有氧系统使用产生的乳酸。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
After completing a good warmup, today we have four repetitions of the following cycle: 30sec  all-out followed by a 90sec at a brisk pace below FTP but still hard enough that it will stress the aerobic system to use lactate produced.

Name: Lactate Clearance
Description:
After completing a good warmup, today we have three repetitions of the following cycle: 30sec ' all-out ' followed by a 90sec at a brisk pace below FTP but still hard enough that it will stress the aerobic system to use lactate produced, and then a further 2min at a more comfortable pace before repeating the cycle. 

We complete two sets of this work before ending the session with 5min in Zone 3 to shuttle lactate that remains in the legs.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
充分热身后，每轮依次完成30秒全力输出、90秒低于FTP但仍有一定强度的骑行，以及2分钟较轻松骑行。每组重复3轮，共完成2组。最后在第3区骑行5分钟，促进乳酸的转运和利用。

英文原文：
After completing a good warmup, today we have three repetitions of the following cycle: 30sec ' all-out ' followed by a 90sec at a brisk pace below FTP but still hard enough that it will stress the aerobic system to use lactate produced, and then a further 2min at a more comfortable pace before repeating the cycle. 

We complete two sets of this work before ending the session with 5min in Zone 3 to shuttle lactate that remains in the legs.

Name: Lactate Fuel
Description:
Another low-intensity session that focuses on building your endurance. However, the key to today's session is the fuel source. 

Lactate becomes the preferred fuel source by completing short 15sec high-intensity surges above your threshold. Today's session is a high carbohydrate burning workout without the prolonged high intensity. 

This workout trains our bodies to use lactate more efficiently and gain endurance.
ChineseDescription:
另一个低强度的训练,重点是建立你的耐力。
然而,今天训练的关键是燃料来源。
通过完成超过阈值的15秒高强度浪涌,乳酸成为首选燃料来源。
今天的训练是一个高碳水化合物燃烧锻炼没有长时间的高强度。
这种锻炼训练我们的身体更有效地使用乳酸,并获得耐力。

Name: Lactate shuttle #1
Description:
Sustaining high levels of lactate requires specific training. This ability to tolerate lactate only comes with precise intervals in training. 

We can all produce a one-off effort to build lactate. With carefully planned intervals, we can maintain this high lactate level for an extended period. This is where the training effect happens!

这种耐受乳酸的能力仅在训练中具有精确的间歇。
我们都可以一次性地制造乳酸。
通过精心计划的间歇,我们可以在较长的时间内保持这种高乳酸水平。
这就是训练效果发生的地方!

Name: Lactate Threshold #1
Description:
Riding at Lactate Threshold is our primary objective here. We are looking to build time spent at this intensity to improve the ability to manage the accumulated lactate. 

The accumulated lactate will be minimal by completing short efforts at your current threshold, but the training effect is positive.

累积的乳酸将在您当前的阈值完成短暂的训练段,但训练效果是积极的。

Name: Lactate Tolerance 3min
Description: Your ability to build and process large amounts of lactate is a critical factor in cycling performance. To achieve significant levels of lactate requires high-intensity efforts with little recovery. There's no denying today is a big session! Two sets of 3min Max Aerobic with 2min recovery. However, the aim is to increase the power in the 2nd set.

中文要点：

Description: Having a strong threshold is crucial to climbing performance. Whether your goal is to ride as a professional cyclist or to gain fitness, improving your FTP will help you on your journey.

无论您的目标是作为一名专业自行车手骑行还是获得健身,改善您的FTP都将帮助您完成旅程。

Description: This session is all about producing peak 1min power.

Name: Low 30's #1
Description:
When we complete short steep climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. With this in mind, it's vital that our training meets the demands of this movement. 

Today, we perform a range of short, lower cadence intervals at various high intensities.

考虑到这一点,我们的培训必须满足这一运动的要求。
今天,我们在各种高强度下执行一系列短、低踏频间歇。

Name: Maintenance #1
Description:
During periods of reduced training volume and intensity, we can maintain the gains made in training by implementing carefully structured intensity on occasion. 

This session will allow you to maintain your base fitness by touching on short, high-intensity intervals. 

By completing 6 x 30sec intervals with functional recovery, you will keep those fast-twitch muscle fibres in check for when the racing begins.
ChineseDescription:
在减少训练量和强度的时期,我们可以通过偶尔实施精心结构的强度来保持训练中取得的成果。
此训练将允许您通过触摸短,高强度的间歇来保持您的基本健康。
通过完成6 x 30秒的间歇功能恢复,您将在比赛开始时检查这些快速抽搐的肌肉纤维。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

By completing 6 x 30sec intervals with functional recovery, you will keep those fast-twitch muscle fibres in check for when the racing begins.

Name: Maintenance #2
Description:
Not every session has to involve high-intensity efforts. 

Today's session is a low-intensity workout focussing on your aerobic fitness. This will allow you to preserve vital glycogen stores and power up the day's final climb. 

This workout is the kind of session you can perform several times during the week.
ChineseDescription:
并不是每届训练都必须进行高强度的训练段。
今天的训练是一个低强度的锻炼,专注于你的有氧健身。
这将允许您保存重要的糖原存储,并为当天的最后一次攀登提供功率。
这种锻炼是你可以在一周内进行几次的训练。

Name: Max Aerobic
Description: After a good warm-up, prepare yourself for two Max Aerobic intervals with 3min recovery. A well developed VO2max system will allow you to recover from high-intensity efforts faster and increase endurance.

ChineseDescription:
经过良好的热身,准备两个最大有氧间歇3分钟的恢复。
一个发达的VO2max系统可以让你更快地从高强度的训练段中恢复,并增加耐力。

Name: Max Aerobic Climb #1
Description:
With these max Aerobic efforts, we are looking to simulate climbing. We achieve this by riding with a lower cadence, out of the saddle. 

After warming up complete the following; 3 x 3min @ 109% with 3min recovery 10min recovery 4 x 2min @ 115% with 4min recovery. During the intervals, ride out of the saddle as much as possible. It's ok to sit occasionally for 10-20 seconds if needed.

Name: Micro into Threshold
Description:
A high-intensity workout today! The stochastic nature of racing requires you to turn the power on and then off quickly. Quite often leading into a threshold type effort. Sustaining threshold power for long periods is a hard workout. 

Performing micro intervals leading into this effort gives the session another element of specificity.
ChineseDescription:
今天的高强度锻炼!
赛车的随机性质要求你打开电源,然后快速关闭。
经常导致一个阈值类型的训练段。
长时间保持阈值功率是一项艰苦的锻炼。
执行导致这项工作的微间歇使训练具有另一个特异性的元素。

In today's session, we perform 30/15's?30sec hard, followed by 15sec recovery.

微间歇是许多运动员的主要锻炼。
尽管由多个,短,高强度的训练段组成,微间歇是针对VO2max开发的有效方法。
有无限量的变化可能与微小的间歇。
在今天的训练上,我们执行30/15的30秒硬,然后是15秒恢复。

Name: Mitochondria #1
Description:
One of the main aims of our 'Early Base' training phase is to increase mitochondrial density. In basic terms, these are the power stations in your muscles. 

Recent studies have shown that the right amount of high-intensity training can provide the same benefits as traditional Long Slow Distance training. 

By implementing structured intervals of high-intensity power, coupled with the right amount of recovery time, we can boost the density of mitochondria.
ChineseDescription:
我们的“早期基地”训练阶段的主要目标之一是增加线粒体密度。

基本来说,这些都是你肌肉中的发电站。
最近的研究表明,适量的高强度训练可以提供与传统的长慢距离训练相同的好处。
通过实施高强度功率的结构化间歇,加上适当的恢复时间,我们可以提高线粒体的密度。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
One of the main aims of our 'Base' training phase is to increase mitochondrial density. In basic terms, these are the power stations in your muscles. Recent studies have shown that the right amount of high-intensity training can provide the same benefits as traditional Long Slow Distance training. By implementing structured intervals of high-intensity power, coupled with the right amount of recovery time, we can boost the density of mitochondria.

Name: Muscular Endurance #1
Description:
The cadence selected for your intervals will determine the specific muscle fibres that are recruited. 

Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 Tempo intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 65rpm. 

The effort should feel like a weights session, not cardiovascular. Avoid gripping the bars tightly; relax your hands.
ChineseDescription:
为您的间歇选择的节奏将决定招募的特定肌肉纤维。
今天,我们正在执行较低的节奏间歇,但功率更接近阈值。
加热后,训练由4个节奏间歇组成,节奏从70rpm到65rpm不等。
训练段应该感觉像一个权重训练,而不是心血管。
避免紧紧抓住酒吧;放松你的手。

The effort should feel like a weights session, not cardiovascular. Avoid gripping the bars tightly; relax your hands.

Name: MyWhoosh Powertest by Aerotune
Description:
Powertest by aerotune.com takes the guesswork out of your training. 

The Powertest is a high-performance testing tool developed for pro cycling. The Powertest tells you way more than your threshold; it tells you how it is composed! The system will calculate your VO2max and VLamax. Combined with your body weight, body fat and gender, the Powertest shows you how your threshold is composed and which training suits you best. 

Protocol: 
- Warm-up for 20 minutes (easy) 
- 10-second seated sprint 
- Ride easy for 10 minutes 
- Start the ramp test till exhaustion 
- Ride easy for 30 minutes 
- Ride a constant all-out effort for 12 minutes. 
- Cool down for 6 minutes 
- Save the data and upload it to https://aerotune.com/powertest

Name: MyWhoosh Ramp Test
Description: Welcome to the Whoosh Ramp test! Today we measure your Maximal Aerobic Power by ramping up the power every minute until exhaustion. From this effort, we use your peak 1min power to calculate your FTP. This method of testing takes less time to complete than the traditional 20min FTP test, and it also removes the component of pacing from the effort. After completing a low-intensity 5min warmup, the power will then increase each minute until you reach failure. It's not necessary to complete each step. Your FTP will be calculated from your peak 1min power produced. It is important to remain seated for this test to provide accurate results. Be prepared... the test starts comfortably, but quickly changes! NOTE: ERG mode MUST be on.
ChineseDescription:
欢迎来到Woosh Ramp测试!
今天,我们通过每分钟提高功率,直到耗尽,测量您的最大有氧功率。
从这个训练段,我们使用你的峰值1min功率来计算你的FTP。
与传统的20min FTP测试相比,这种测试方法需要更少的时间完成,并且从训练段中消除了配速的组件。
完成低强度的5分钟热身后,每分钟功率就会增加,直到你达到失败。
没有必要完成每一步。
您的 FTP 将从您产生的峰值 1 分钟 功率计算出来。
重要的是要保持坐姿,以提供准确的结果。
准备好...
测试开始舒适,但很快变化!
注意:ERG模式必须开启。

After completing a low-intensity 5min warmup, the power will then increase each minute until you reach failure. It's not necessary to complete each step. Your FTP will be calculated from your peak 1min power produced. It is important to remain seated for this test to provide accurate results. Be prepared... the test starts comfortably, but quickly changes! NOTE: ERG mode MUST be on.

Name: Neuromuscular Power #1
Description:
After warming up, set your pace at a lower end Tempo effort for the next 30 minutes. Within these 30 minutes, you will be performing a 10 second out of the saddle sprint every 5 minutes. Aim for a high cadence in sprints with 1 - 2 gear changes into a harder gear during the effort. 

Can you hit the same Peak Power for all six sprints?

在这30分钟内,您将每5分钟进行一次马鞍冲刺10秒。
目标是在冲刺中保持高节奏,在训练段过程中将1 - 2档变成更硬的齿轮。
你能在所有六个冲刺中达到相同的峰值功率吗?

Name: Neuromuscular Power Surges #1
Description:
Training the neuromuscular system is one of the most effective ways to improve your efficiency. This system includes all the muscles in the body and the nerves that serve them. In this workout, we aim to recruit the maximal amount of muscle fibres. 

We do this by completing a series of short, high powered efforts with slight recovery. As the muscles tire, more are recruited to produce the power. 

With two sets of 10 surges, you will be calling upon every fibre you have to produce the power by the last interval!
ChineseDescription:
训练神经肌肉系统是提高效率的最有效的方法之一。
这个系统包括身体中的所有肌肉和为其服务的神经。
在这个锻炼中,我们的目标是招募肌肉纤维的最大量。
我们通过完成一系列短,高功率的训练段,并略有恢复来实现这一点。
随着肌肉的轮胎,更多的被招募来产生功率。
有了两组10个浪涌,你将召唤每一个你必须在最后一个时间间歇产生能量的纤维!

Name: Open Road
Description:
Long, comfortable aerobic passages provide time to settle into a sustainable rhythm without demanding frequent changes in effort.

Today, we alternate two longer, easier passages with shorter, slightly stronger sections. Keep each change gentle and the riding relaxed throughout.
ChineseDescription:
长而舒适的有氧通道为适应可持续的节奏提供了时间,而不需要频繁地改变训练段。
今天,我们交替两个更长,更容易的段落与更短,略强的部分。
保持每一个变化温柔和骑在整个放松。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Over and out
Description: Working at the top end of your threshold today. Maybe a little anaerobic along the way!
ChineseDescription:
今天在你的阈值的顶端工作。
一路上可能有点无氧!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Working at the top end of your threshold today. Maybe a little anaerobic along the way!

Name: Over Ones
Description:
With various efforts, this high-intensity session looks at your ability to produce quality race efforts over 1 minute in duration. 

With ample recovery between the intervals, you will be able to produce your best efforts for the target duration.
ChineseDescription:
通过各种训练段,这个高强度的训练看看你的能力,在持续时间超过1分钟。
在间歇之间有充足的恢复,您将能够在目标持续时间内做出最佳训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
With various efforts, this high-intensity session looks at your ability to produce quality race efforts over 1 minute in duration.

Name: Over Under Efforts #1

In this session, you will experience both the pushing and pulling type efforts from previous weeks, But without the recovery, you are used to.
ChineseDescription:

在这个训练中,您将体验前几周推动和拉动型的训练段,但如果没有恢复,您习惯了。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Pace is the trick
Description: We improve your muscular endurance power by completing extended high power intervals?2 different sets of work today.

我们通过完成延长的高功率间歇来提高您的肌肉耐力能力? 2 今天不同的工作组。

We improve your muscular endurance power by completing extended high power intervals?2 different sets of work today.

Description:
A low-intensity endurance session that focuses on your ability to judge your pacing. By completing some steady-state intervals under threshold power, you will develop the ability to gauge your effort based on 'feel' without having to look at the data for feedback. 

This session also serves the purpose of effectively building endurance.

这次训练还有助于有效地建立耐力的目的。

Sometimes the best workout has no power ceiling! You have trained hard to improve your anaerobic abilities, and today is the day to record the fruits of your labour.

Name: Peak Power!
Description: After completing a structured warm-up, the session is completed as a 'Free Ride'. However, throughout the session, you will be prompted to perform 6 x 3-5sec max sprints. The aim is to hit your Pmax values. Sprints are very short @ 3-5sec, generally needing only 6-10 pedal strokes. Use any gear necessary to produce high power. Aim to choose a course with minimal elevation gain for this session.

我们的目标是达到你的Pmax值。
Sprint在3-5秒时非常短,通常只需要6-10个踏板行程。
使用任何必要的齿轮来产生高功率。
旨在为本次训练选择具有最小海拔增益的课程。

Name: Phosphate 20
Description:
This session will have you replicating crossing a short gap in a race. These are NOT max efforts. They are big gear, lower cadence bursts. With ample recovery between efforts, hit each one out of the saddle in a big gear. 

Wind it up and cross the gap just as you would in a race!
ChineseDescription:
这次训练将让你复制在比赛中跨越一个短的差距。
这不是最大的训练段。
他们是大齿轮,低踏频的爆破。
随着训练段之间的充分恢复,击中每一个马鞍在一个大齿轮。
把它卷起来,像在比赛中一样跨越差距!

Name: Phosphate 6
Description: Using short, high cadence 'surges', with little recovery, we are challenging your aerobic system today. Because these are high cadence efforts, there is no need for many gear changes, if any. Just stay seated and increase cadence and power. After each 'surge' take note of your heart rate throughout the intervals. Is it returning to resting levels each time, or climbing throughout the intervals?
ChineseDescription:
使用短,高踏频的“浪涌”,几乎没有恢复,我们今天正在挑战您的有氧系统。
因为这些都是高踏频的训练段,所以没有必要进行许多换档,如果有的话。
只要保持坐姿,增加踏频和功率。
每次“浪涌”后,在整个间歇内注意你的心率。
是每次回到休息水平,还是在整个间歇期间攀登?

Name: Position, Position!
Description:
Sometimes you need to go deep to get a better position! Often, racing requires fast starts and high power afterwards to stay at the front. 

This workout will have you replicating the demands of going well outside your comfort zone and then having to keep going!
ChineseDescription:
有时你需要深入,以获得更好的位置!
通常,赛车需要快速启动和高功率之后留在前面。
这个锻炼将让你复制去你的舒适区之外,然后不得不继续前进的要求!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

This workout will have you replicating the demands of going well outside your comfort zone and then having to keep going!

Description: Today's session focuses on improving your ability to produce power. To be able to turn a big gear faster.
ChineseDescription:
今天的训练重点是提高你发电的能力。
能够更快地转动一个大齿轮。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Today's session focuses on improving your ability to produce power. To be able to turn a big gear faster.

Name: Power Intervals #1
Description:
Today's session focuses on improving your ability to produce power. To be able to turn a big gear faster. Completing high power intervals with slightly less cadence increases the torque applied to the crank, boosting muscular endurance power. 

Two sets of (3 x 2.5min) with 3min recovery. However, the initial high power 30sec effort has a target cadence of 85rpm before completing the remaining 2min at a self-selected cadence.
ChineseDescription:

Name: Power Passport
Description:
Hello and welcome to the MyWhoosh Power Passport test. We understand that keeping track of your fitness and training progress can be challenging, but it is vital to maintaining your Power Profile. We also know that monitoring threshold power alone isn't enough; that's why we measure other aspects of your performance too. 

The MyWhoosh Power Passport test is designed to simulate competition demands by measuring maximum efforts for fixed periods and providing your current FTP data. We want to help you achieve your fitness goals and improve your performance; this test is a crucial step towards that. 

After a warm-up, the test will include intervals of Free-Riding, where you'll need to produce maximal efforts, followed by fixed recovery periods. We understand that this may be challenging, but we're here to support you every step of the way. Please remember that ERG mode is necessary and will automatically turn off during free-ride intervals, so you can focus on giving your best effort. 

We want you to succeed and reach your full potential. Thank you for choosing MyWhoosh, and we wish you the best of luck with your Power Passport test.

我们还知道仅监控阈值功率是不够的;这也是我们衡量您性能的其他方面的原因。
MyWhoosh Power Passport 测试旨在通过测量固定时间的最大训练段并提供您当前的 FTP 数据来模拟竞争需求。

我们知道这可能是具有挑战性的,但我们在这里支持您的每一步。

Name: Power Reps #1
Description: Remain seated whilst completing the power efforts. We don't want to stress the heart rate too much during the effort. Rather, letting the legs do the majority of the work. When climbing in the real world, it is good practice to start steady and ramp up the effort as you come to crest the climb. In reality, it is easy to hit the climb too hard! This is a good session to condition you to ride climbs smartly and effectively.

实际上,很容易撞到爬坡太难了!
