Name: Pre-Race Session #2
Description:
The 'Pre-Race' session is an essential aspect of your taper. Generally, your taper will involve a period of reduced volume and low-intensity training. But it's necessary to have that final workout of high intensity before your event. 

The 'Pre-Race' session serves to activate the muscles and prepare you for the high intensity of racing. Ideally, you have had two days of light training before completing this session.

但是,在你的活动之前,必须有高强度的最终锻炼。
“Pre-Race”训练旨在激活肌肉,并为高强度的比赛做好准备。
理想情况下,在完成本课程之前,您已经接受了两天的轻度训练。

Name: Progressive Climb #2
Description:
After warming up, you will be completing 2 x 11-minute 'progressive' intervals. 

Starting with a comfortable sub-threshold effort, you will finish with a 1min above threshold effort. Finally, the session is completed with a 10-minute steady threshold effort. 

After completing two progressive intervals, the final effort should feel relatively comfortable.

热身后,您将完成2×11分钟的“进步”间歇。
从舒适的阈值以下训练段开始,您将完成超过阈值的训练段1分钟。
最后,训练以10分钟的稳定阈值训练段完成。
在完成两个渐进的间歇后,最终的训练段应该感觉相对舒服。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Prologue
Description: This workout takes you through a prologue. These are short, time trial stages that are usually at the start of a stage race. They present another opportunity for the sprinters to take victory as the short and had nature of the race suits the capacities of the sprinters. By simulating a prologue effort we will work on your high-end powers and get you to put your training of previous weeks to the test!
ChineseDescription:
这个练习将带您通过序幕。
这些是短暂的,计时阶段,通常在阶段比赛开始时。
他们为冲刺型车手提供了另一个机会,以冲刺型车手的身份取得胜利,并且比赛的性质适合冲刺型车手的能力。
通过模拟序幕训练段,我们将训练段提高您的高端能力,并让您将前几周的训练付诸测试!

Name: Pure Strength #1
Description: Pure Strength #1 Today is all about producing extremely high crank torque. The higher the crank torque, the more fast twitch fibres being recruited. These are the muscle fibres that rarely get trained, meaning there is room for improved performance if these fibres are targeted. But to achieve this high crank torque requires high power, with very low rpm. After each set of Pure Strength efforts you will complete 10 minutes at a tempo pace. However, you will be prompted to complete 3 high rpm maximal sprints along the way.
ChineseDescription:
Pure Strength #1 今天是关于产生非常高的曲柄扭矩。
曲柄扭矩越高,被招募的抽搐纤维就越快。
这些是很少接受训练的肌肉纤维,这意味着如果这些纤维成为靶向,则有改进性能的空间。
但是要达到这种高曲柄扭矩需要高功率,转速非常低。
在每组纯功率训练段后,您将以节奏完成10分钟。
但是,您将被提示完成 3 个高 rpm 最大冲刺。

Name: Push and Pull #1
Description: Progressing from the threshold efforts of the past weeks, but introducing some pulling intervals. These are supra-threshold efforts, just above your FTP. If the pushing intervals are designed to push your threshold up from below, these effectively pull your threshold up from above.

这些是超阈值的训练段,就在您的FTP之上。
如果推移间歇被设计为将阈值从下面推高,则这些间歇有效地将阈值从上方拉高。

Description:
This is your day to finish the race strongly! Coming into the backend of a race is where the fireworks begin. To be competitive, you will need to back up your first attack with several others. 

Today, you will dominate the finale and gradually whittle the group down with repeated attacks. While performing these efforts, visualise yourself attacking the winning break of the day!

今天,你将主导结局,并逐渐通过反复的攻击削弱团体。
在执行这些训练段的同时,想象自己攻击当天的胜利休息!

Name: Race Pace #1
Description: This session is designed to build your sustainable threshold power. Working at your threshold is a key determinant of success. In Gravel racing, there are often key moments that decide the outcome. Being able to produce high power for a duration of 5 to 20 minutes is crucial in race-winning moves. Today we focus on this domain. 3x8 minute intervals at your FTP. You should have dialled in your FTP after the test from a few weeks ago. If not, I recommend completing another FTP test before completing this session.
ChineseDescription:
这次训练旨在建立您的可持续阈值能力。
在你的阈值上工作是成功的关键决定因素。
在砾石赛车中,往往有关键时刻决定结果。
能够在5到20分钟的持续时间内产生高功率对于赢得比赛的动作至关重要。
今天我们专注于这个领域。
3x8分钟间歇在您的FTP。
您应该在几周前的测试后拨打您的FTP。
如果没有,我建议在完成此训练之前完成另一个FTP测试。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This session is designed to build your sustainable threshold power. Working at your threshold is a key determinant of success. In Gravel racing, there are often key moments that decide the outcome. Being able to produce high power for a duration of 5 to 20 minutes is crucial in race-winning moves. Today we focus on this domain. 3x8 minute intervals at your FTP. You should have dialled in your FTP after the test from a few weeks ago. If not, I recommend completing another FTP test before completing this session.

Name: Race Pace #1
Description:
Today's session consists of 5 x 5-minute race pace intervals. However, the target power will ramp up throughout the interval just as under race conditions. 

Focus on controlled breathing and pedalling at a cadence similar to your race cadence during the intervals.

专注于受控呼吸和踏板的踏频类似于你的比赛踏频在间歇。

Name: Race Preparation - Road Race
Description:
Leading into your key event or race period, the final steps in your preparation involve a balance of rest and recovery. 

Generally, this consists of beginning to taper 7-10 days from your event and balancing training with a mix of recovery and intensity. Along with a reduced training volume, a workout featuring a calculated combination of intensity will have you in peak form for race day. 

Ideally, this workout would be completed 3-4 days before your race, with adequate recovery before and after the session.

除了减少的训练量外,通过计算强度组合的锻炼将使您在比赛日达到高峰。
理想情况下,这项锻炼将在比赛前3-4天完成,并在训练前后充分恢复。

Name: Race Ready
Description: If you're a fan of indoor racing, you know firsthand the excitement and speed involved. Experienced indoor racers also know that the opening minutes of an event are intense!To perform at your best, it's crucial to prepare your body beforehand. A proper warmup gradually increases your heart rate, blood flow, and body temperature, enhancing your muscle efficiency. Additionally, it provides oxygen and nutrients to your working muscles, improving your performance.But the benefits of a warmup aren't only physical. It also mentally prepares you for the challenge ahead. By enhancing your focus, concentration, and confidence, you'll be able to perform at your best and achieve your goals.Be sure to time your warmup to finish 10 minutes before your race starts. This way, you'll have time to grab another water bottle and enter the start pen. Best of luck to you!

如果你是室内赛车的粉丝,你会第一手了解所涉及的兴奋和速度。
经验丰富的室内赛车手也知道,比赛的开场时间非常激烈!为了发挥最佳状态,提前准备身体至关重要。
适当的热身会逐渐增加你的心率、血流量和体温,从而提高肌肉效率。
此外,它为您的工作肌肉提供氧气和营养,提高您的表现。 但热身的好处不仅仅是身体上的。
它也在精神上为前方的挑战做好准备。
通过提高你的专注力,专注力和自信,你将能够以最佳状态表现并实现你的目标。 确保你的热身时间在你的比赛开始前10分钟完成。
通过这种方式,您将有时间抓住另一个水瓶并进入起始笔。
祝你好运!

Name: Race Ready + SRC
Description: SRC is here! Make sure you have everything you need a couple of hours before the race. That includes laying out your race kit, water bottles, nutrition, towels, headphones, and anything else you need for SRC. 45-60min before the race, it's time to get ready. Once you are kitted up, you can begin your warmup. Aim to finish your warmup 10-20min before the start of the race so that you have plenty of time to refuel, rehydrate, and grab anything else you might need. If you've done your homework during the week, you will know the key points to look out for. SRC offers hard racing from start to finish, so you will need to be ready for anything. Dig deep and give it your best effort today!

Name: Ramp Test - MyWhoosh
Description:
Welcome to the MyWhoosh Ramp test! Today, we measure your Maximal Aerobic Power by ramping up the power every minute until exhaustion. We use your peak 1min power from this effort to calculate your FTP. 
   
This testing method takes less time to complete than the traditional 20-minute FTP test, and it also removes the pacing component from the effort. After completing a low-intensity 5-minute warmup, the power will increase each minute until you reach failure. It's not necessary to complete each step. Your FTP will be calculated from your peak 1min power produced.
    
It is important to remain seated for this test to provide accurate results. 
    
Be prepared... the test starts comfortably but quickly changes!

NOTE: ERG mode MUST be on.

*Ramp Test protocol developed by Ric Stern, CycleCoach.com
ChineseDescription:
欢迎来到MyWoosh Ramp测试!
今天,我们通过每分钟增加功率,直到耗尽,测量您的最大有氧功率。
我们使用您的峰值1min功率从这个训练段来计算您的FTP。
与传统的20分钟FTP测试相比,这种测试方法需要更少的时间来完成,并且它还从工作中消除了配速组件。
在完成低强度的5分钟热身后,每分钟功率都会增加,直到你达到失败。
没有必要完成每一步。
您的 FTP 将从您产生的峰值 1 分钟 功率计算出来。
重要的是要保持坐姿,以提供准确的结果。
准备好...
测试开始舒适,但很快变化!
注意:ERG模式必须开启。
* Ric Stern, CycleCoach.com 开发的 Ramp 测试协议

Name: Relentless
Description:
The Effort Keeps coming and the recovery never fully arrives. This session is all about producing power when it matters most. Repeated 40-second surges above FTP challenge your anaerobic system, while limited recovery teaches you to keep performing when fatigue starts to build.

Expect a tough but rewarding workout that develops explosive efforts, race-winning accelerations, and the ability to respond to attacks deep into an event.

If you're looking to build strength above threshold and sharpen your race-day fitness, this workout delivers.

在FTP上方重复40秒的浪涌挑战你的无氧系统,而有限的恢复教你在疲劳开始构建时继续执行。
期待一个艰难但有益的锻炼,发展爆炸性的训练段,赢得比赛的加速,以及应对事件深入攻击的能力。
如果您希望在阈值以上建立功率并提高您的比赛日健身,此锻炼可以提供。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
The Effort Keeps coming and the recovery never fully arrives. This session is all about producing power when it matters most. Repeated 40-second surges above FTP challenge your anaerobic system, while limited recovery teaches you to keep performing when fatigue starts to build.

Expect a tough but rewarding workout that develops explosive efforts, race-winning accelerations, and the ability to respond to attacks deep into an event.

If you're looking to build strength above threshold and sharpen your race-day fitness, this workout delivers.

Name: Rest Day OR Free-ride volume
Description: Use today in a way that best suits your needs. Take a well-deserved rest day, or if looking to increase your weekly volume, today is the perfect day to achieve this. Your focus each week should first be on completing the set interval workouts. However, if you have the time available to increase your weekly volume, then Zone 2 endurance riding will complement your training plan. Long periods within Zone 2 will benefit any athlete. In this training Zone, we predominately stimulate Type 1 muscle fibres, leading to increased mitochondrial growth and function. You improve your ability to utilise fat as the preferred fuel source and preserve your precious glycogen stores with endurance training. To achieve this riding time within Zone 2, options include joining a low-intensity group ride, or performing a free-ride over a predominately flat course.

为了在2区内实现这个骑行时间,选择包括加入低强度团体骑行,或在主要平坦的赛道上进行自由骑行。

Name: Rolling Hills #1

This endurance session focuses on replicating the demands of outdoor rolling hills. Like in real life, we have a targeted lower cadence for the hills, but the power is well under threshold.

这种锻炼的身体涉及重复中等强度的训练段,长度从2到3分钟不等。

Name: Rolling Pressure Over Unders
Description:
Threshold power isn't built through big efforts—it's built by learning to stay strong when the pressure never quite goes away.

Rolling Pressure is a classic over-under workout that repeatedly takes you just below and just above FTP. These controlled changes in intensity teach your body to process lactate more efficiently while maintaining a strong, sustainable effort.

The individual efforts may feel manageable, but as the workout progresses the accumulated fatigue starts to build. Success comes from staying smooth, controlled, and disciplined throughout every transition.

Focus Areas

FTP Development

Lactate Clearance

Threshold Durability

Pacing Control

Sustainable Power
ChineseDescription:
阈值权力不是通过大训练段建立的 - 它是通过在压力永远不会消失时学会保持强大而建立的。
滚动压力是一种经典的过度锻炼,反复带你略低于FTP,略高于FTP。
这些受控的强度变化教会你的身体更有效地处理乳酸,同时保持强大的,可持续的训练段。
个人的训练段可能感觉可以管理,但随着锻炼的进展,累积的疲劳开始建立。
成功来自于在每一个过渡过程中保持平稳、受控和纪律。
重点领域
FTP开发
乳酸清除剂
阈值耐久性
调速控制
可持续功率

Name: Rolling Stage

The first 'race-day' simulation of this Climbing Focussed Plan. As we progress through the phases, the training focus becomes more intense and direct towards the end goal. 

Today we take you through a rolling route of different climbs to push your threshold up and improve your climbing powers. We are taking you through a typical race-day situation!

Name: Rolling Tempo
Description: Changes in intensity are a natural part of riding on rolling terrain and can make aerobic training more engaging while still keeping the overall effort controlled. Today, the effort gradually rises and falls as you ride through a series of rolling aerobic efforts. Stay relaxed as the power increases and use the easier sections to settle back into your rhythm.

今天,当你乘坐一系列滚动有氧运动时,训练段逐渐上升和下降。
随着功率的增加,保持放松,并使用更容易的部分来适应你的节奏。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

时间间歇为耐久性和耐疲劳性奠定了基础。

Name: SFR Split Cadence
Description: This SFR (Slow-Frequency-Revolution) workout is a split focus session, getting you working at two different cadences ranges. In the Base Phases, there are a lot of long, slow distance miles: Not the best sessions to simulate on the trainer! But there is a focus on 'foundation' training too. 因此,跟随这个SFR锻炼,因为我们经历了早期基础阶段训练的面包和黄油!

Description: Building endurance doesn't just involve long, low power efforts. In this session, we challenge your aerobic fitness with various efforts.

Name: Short Climb Race Simulation
Description:
Climbing encompasses a range of durations and intensities, especially when it comes to racing up those climbs! 

You are drawing on all of your hard work in the preceding weeks. Today is the day to push yourself and show us what you have got! Today we simulate a race situation with multiple short climbs.

攀登包括一系列持续时间和强度,特别是在攀登这些攀登时!
你正在利用你之前几周的所有辛勤工作。
今天是推自己,并告诉我们你有什么!
今天,我们模拟了多次短攀登的竞赛情况。

Name: Small Hills, Long Roads
Description:
Occasional controlled changes of pace can add interest while long stretches of aerobic riding remain the main training stimulus. Settling back promptly is more important than pushing the lifts harder.

Today, we ride four brief hills within long aerobic passages. Keep each hill measured, return smoothly to your cruising effort, and finish with eight steady minutes.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
以长时间有氧骑行为主，穿插4段短坡。控制每次爬坡强度，之后平顺回到巡航输出；比起把坡段骑得更猛，及时恢复稳定节奏更重要。最后稳定骑行8分钟。

英文原文：
Occasional controlled changes of pace can add interest while long stretches of aerobic riding remain the main training stimulus. Settling back promptly is more important than pushing the lifts harder.

Today, we ride four brief hills within long aerobic passages. Keep each hill measured, return smoothly to your cruising effort, and finish with eight steady minutes.

Name: Speed Sprints
Description:
Today we are looking for leg speed! Power is not the focus, so with this in mind, the 'speed' intervals are performed as a 'free-ride' section. 

With no target power in the sprints, you can focus on fast legs for the effort. The goal is long sprints with high cadence!
ChineseDescription:
今天我们正在寻找腿部速度!
功率不是焦点,因此考虑到这一点,“速度”间歇作为“自由骑行”部分执行。
在冲刺中没有目标功率,您可以专注于快速腿以进行训练段。
我们的目标是高踏频的长冲刺!

Name: Spiked Aerobic
Description: Interval training doesn't always need to have periods of low-intensity recovery. In today's session, we are completing short Zone 3 efforts with a more extended rest period which has some intensity to it. The intensity is low enough that the interval can be completed comfortably, yet still creating enough of a stress to improve aerobic capabilities.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
间歇训练不一定都采用低强度恢复。本课以较短的第3区发力，搭配时间较长但仍保留一定强度的恢复段，既保持可控的完成难度，也为有氧能力提供训练刺激。

英文原文：
Interval training doesn't always need to have periods of low-intensity recovery. In today's session, we are completing short Zone 3 efforts with a more extended rest period which has some intensity to it. The intensity is low enough that the interval can be completed comfortably, yet still creating enough of a stress to improve aerobic capabilities.

他们也将加大训练段。

Name: Sprints - High Speed Start
Description:
After completing a structured warm-up, the session is conducted as a 'Free Ride'. However, throughout the session, you will be prompted to complete 6 x 12sec max sprints starting from HIGH speed. 

Begin sprint in a gear that allows you to reach ~100rpm after 12sec. No gear changes during the sprint. 

Aim to choose a course with a minimal elevation gain for this session.

开始冲刺,让你在12秒后达到约100rpm。
在Sprint期间没有换档。
旨在为本届训练选择具有最小海拔增益的课程。

Name: Sprints - Low Speed Start
Description:
After completing a structured warm-up, the session is conducted as a 'Free Ride'. However, throughout the session, you will be prompted to complete 6 x 12sec max sprints starting from LOW speed. 

Begin sprint in a gear that allows you to reach ~100rpm after 12sec. No gear changes during the sprint. 

Aim to choose a course with a minimal elevation gain for this session.
ChineseDescription:
在完成结构化热身后,训练以“免费乘车”的形式进行。
但是,在整个训练中,系统会提示您从低速开始完成6 x 12sec max sprint。
开始冲刺,让你在12秒后达到约100rpm。
在Sprint期间没有换档。
旨在为本届训练选择具有最小海拔增益的课程。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
After completing a structured warm-up, the session is conducted as a 'Free Ride'. However, throughout the session, you will be prompted to complete 6 x 12sec max sprints starting from LOW speed. 

Begin sprint in a gear that allows you to reach ~100rpm after 12sec. No gear changes during the sprint. 

Aim to choose a course with a minimal elevation gain for this session.

Name: Sprints into Zone 3 #1
Description: High-intensity work is a little easier when fresh. In today's workout, the aim is to produce high intensity when fatigued.
ChineseDescription:
高强度的工作在新鲜时更容易一些。
在今天的锻炼中,目标是在疲劳时产生高强度。

Name: Sprints into Zone 3 #1
Description: Quite often we need to perform a series off hard accelerations to better position ourselves for a critical part of the race. These above threshold efforts result in the accumulation of lactate which becomes the preferred fuel source. But there's no time to rest. Once you have fought for position, you will need to keep the pressure on the pedals to stay at the front of the race.
ChineseDescription:
很多时候,我们需要执行一系列硬加速度,以更好地定位自己在比赛的关键部分。
这些高于阈值的训练段导致乳酸的积累,乳酸成为首选的燃料来源。
但是没有时间休息。
一旦你为位置而战,你需要保持踏板的压力,以保持在比赛的前面。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Once you have fought for position, you will need to keep the pressure on the pedals to stay at the front of the race.

Name: Steady Climbing #3
Description:
You are focusing on strength endurance work today by completing steady, low cadence intervals. Strength Endurance increases crank torque and recruits more of your fast-twitch muscle fibres. 

Strength Endurance type work has been a staple session of riders for many years.
ChineseDescription:
你今天通过完成稳定,低踏频间歇来专注于力量耐力工作。
强度 耐力增加曲柄扭矩,并招募更多的快速抽搐肌肉纤维。
力量耐力型工作多年来一直是骑手的主要训练。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Strength Endurance type work has been a staple session of riders for many years.

Name: Steady Climbing #4
Description:
Three climbs of 11 minutes in duration today. However, each one is performed using a different cadence. Like a climb outdoors, the required power will increase throughout the 11 minutes. 

We culminate with a 1 min above threshold at the top of the climb.
ChineseDescription:
今天三次攀登11分钟。
但是,每个都使用不同的踏频进行。
就像在户外攀登一样,所需的功率将在11分钟内增加。
我们达到高潮,在攀登的顶部超过1分钟的阈值。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Step It Up
Description: Moving between different aerobic intensities is a great way to add variety to your endurance training while continuing to build your aerobic fitness. Today, we work through a series of aerobic steps, gradually increasing the effort before bringing it back down. Settle into each new target and keep the effort controlled as you move through the different levels.
ChineseDescription:
在不同的有氧强度之间移动是增加耐力训练多样性的好方法,同时继续建立你的有氧健身。
今天,我们通过一系列的有氧步骤工作,逐渐增加训练段,然后再把它带回来。
进入每个新目标,并在您通过不同级别移动时保持精力控制。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Moving between different aerobic intensities is a great way to add variety to your endurance training while continuing to build your aerobic fitness. Today, we work through a series of aerobic steps, gradually increasing the effort before bringing it back down. Settle into each new target and keep the effort controlled as you move through the different levels.

Name: Step Up Sprints
Description:
These Step up sprints are slightly different to the sprint capacity that we are also doing in this phase - the Step up sprints load the legs gradually through the effort, culminating in a maximal, peak power sprint. This mimics a sprint lead out or even a track sprint. 

This session aims to get you used to rolling a big gear and continually accelerating throughout the sprints: today's short but sharp session.
ChineseDescription:
这些提升冲刺与我们在这个阶段所做的冲刺能力略有不同 - 提升冲刺通过训练段逐渐加载腿部,最终达到最大,峰值功率冲刺。
这模仿了冲刺领先甚至赛道冲刺。
这次训练的目的是让你习惯于滚动一个大齿轮,并在整个冲刺中不断加速:今天的短暂但锋利的训练。

This session aims to get you used to rolling a big gear and continually accelerating throughout the sprints: today's short but sharp session.

Interval training can also include more than 1 Training Zone. Stepped intervals require you to progress your way through the various Zones. 

Generally, the duration of each interval is decreased as the intensity increases. Today's session will you see step through Zones 2, 3, 4 and 5.

今天的训练将看到步骤通过区域2,3,4和5。

Name: Strength Endurance
Description: This session is a split-focus workout. With an emphasis on endurance in the relatively short time we have available. Often there is no substitute to time on the bike, but this type of workout is very good at increasing your endurance capacity. The main intervals are 4 x 7 minutes, where the first 5 minutes are completed at a high cadence, followed by 2 minutes at a lower rpm and slightly higher power. Whilst technically easier, the first 10 minutes may feel tougher for you, due to the high cadence and strain it puts on the heart and respiratory system.
ChineseDescription:
本次训练是分焦点的锻炼。
强调在相对较短的时间内耐力,我们有可用的。
通常没有替代时间骑自行车,但这种类型的锻炼非常善于增加你的耐力能力。
主间歇为4 x 7分钟,其中前5分钟以高踏频完成,然后在较低的转速和略高的功率下完成2分钟。
虽然技术上更容易,但前10分钟可能会让你感觉更艰难,因为它对心脏和呼吸系统带来高踏频和压力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This session is a split-focus workout. With an emphasis on endurance in the relatively short time we have available. Often there is no substitute to time on the bike, but this type of workout is very good at increasing your endurance capacity. The main intervals are 4 x 7 minutes, where the first 5 minutes are completed at a high cadence, followed by 2 minutes at a lower rpm and slightly higher power. Whilst technically easier, the first 10 minutes may feel tougher for you, due to the high cadence and strain it puts on the heart and respiratory system.

Name: Strength Endurance Rotations
Description: This early phase of training is about building a base for higher intensity work later in the plan. It's also the phase where we look to extend our endurance capabilities. One such method to achieve this is through Strength Endurance work. Strength Endurance intervals on the bike are targeted around delivering high crank torque. To do this, we produce high power with low cadence. This high crank torque engages more of your fast-twitch fibers, which allows you to gain endurance. However, the target power is below your FTP, allowing you to extend the effort.

这个训练的早期阶段是关于在计划后期为更高强度的工作建立一个基础。
这也是我们希望扩展耐力能力的阶段。
实现这一目标的方法之一是通过强度耐力工作。
自行车上的强度 耐力间歇是围绕提供高曲柄扭矩的目标。
为此,我们以低踏频生产高功率。
这种高曲柄扭矩可吸引更多的快速抽动纤维,从而让您获得耐力。
但是,目标功率低于您的FTP,允许您扩展工作。

以稳定的低踏频间歇练习力量耐力，增加曲柄扭矩并募集快肌纤维。热身并完成一段自由耐力骑行后，进行2组、每组10分钟的力量耐力训练。每组最后以20秒高踏频输出结束，注意全程遵循目标踏频。

英文原文：
You are focussing on Strength Endurance work by completing steady, low cadence intervals. Strength Endurance increases crank torque and therefore recruits more of your fast-twitch muscle fibres. After warming up and completing a period of endurance 'free-riding', you will complete 2 x 10min min Strength Endurance intervals. However, each SE effort is finished off with a 20sec high cadence effort. Take note of the target cadence throughout the session.

Name: Strength Tempo #1
Description:
The cadence selected for your intervals will determine the specific muscle fibres that are recruited. 

Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. 

All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near-threshold finale!

加热后,训练由4个间歇组成,踏频从70rpm到95rpm不等。
所有这一切都让你准备好高踏频,接近阈值的结局!

Name: Structured Pace Run (Hard)
Description: Run 5km total with three sets of 4min Tempo intervals (70-80% of Max HR) with 2min recovery. The session will look like this: 10min warmup, 3x4min Tempo, and a 5-10min cool down.

Description: After warming up, the session focuses on Sub-threshold work. However, complete 8 minutes at Zone 2 Endurance prior.

Name: Sub Threshold #1
Description: To build endurance and aerobic efficiency, we need to perform long, steady efforts. Today's session comprises of 2 x 15-minute Sub Threshold efforts. After opening the interval with a 30-second zone 5 surge, the remaining 15 minutes will gradually increase in power throughout the effort. Observe how much this increase in power affects your heart rate.
ChineseDescription:
为了建立耐力和有氧效率,我们需要进行长期,稳定的训练段。
今天的训练包括2 x 15分钟的子阈值训练段。
在以30秒区域5浪涌打开间歇后,剩余的15分钟将在整个训练段中逐渐增加功率。
观察这种功率的增加对你的心率的影响有多大。

Description:

Name: Supra-Threshold #1
Description:
Working beyond your threshold point will result in lactate accumulation, and you will fatigue very quickly. Raising the power, you can produce at this threshold is of paramount importance for any rider. 

This supra-threshold session of 4x 5 minutes will have you working at just above your anaerobic threshold power.
ChineseDescription:
超出阈值的工作将导致乳酸积累,你会很快疲劳。
提高功率,你可以在这个阈值上生产对任何骑手来说都是至关重要的。
这个4x5分钟的超阈值训练将让你在略高于无氧阈值功率的工作。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Supra-Threshold #2
Description:
Raising the power, you can produce at the threshold is of paramount importance for any rider. This supra-threshold session of 4x 5 minutes will have you working at just above your anaerobic threshold power. But be prepared for the sting in the tail! 

The effort is completed with a low cadence and high power burst. Just as you would experience when powering over a steep hill.
ChineseDescription:
提高功率,你可以在阈值上生产对任何骑手来说都是至关重要的。
这个4x5分钟的超阈值训练将让你在略高于无氧阈值功率的工作。
但要为尾巴上的刺做好准备!
这项工作以低踏频和高功率爆破完成。
就像你在陡峭的山上供电时所经历的一样。

Name: Sweetspot #2
Description:
Long climbs often require extensive efforts of low cadence. When we complete long climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. 

After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. With this in mind, it's vital that our training meets the demands of the event. 

All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near-threshold finale!
ChineseDescription:
长时间的攀登往往需要大量的低踏频的训练段。
当我们完成长爬坡时,较低的踏频会导致高曲柄扭矩,从而吸引更多的快肌纤维。
加热后,训练由4个间歇组成,踏频从70rpm到95rpm不等。
今天,我们正在执行较低的踏频间歇,但功率更接近阈值。
考虑到这一点,我们的培训必须满足活动的要求。
所有这一切都让你准备好高踏频,接近阈值的结局!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Long climbs often require extensive efforts of low cadence. When we complete long climbs, the lower cadence results in high crank torque, which recruits more of your fast-twitch fibres. 

After warming up, the session consists of 4 intervals with cadence varying from 70rpm to 95rpm. Today we are performing lower cadence intervals but with power closer to threshold. With this in mind, it's vital that our training meets the demands of the event. 

All this gets you ready for a high cadence, near-threshold finale!

Name: Sweetspot #3
Description:
Many riding and racing often require you to ride at a steady tempo for long periods. However, you will also have to accelerate above your threshold to pass other riders as you move up the bunch or crest a hill. 

Today's workout focuses on steady efforts interspersed with short accelerations. Incorporating sprint efforts into a steady-state effort will recruit additional muscle fibres and extend their ability to work aerobically.
ChineseDescription:
许多骑行和赛车经常要求您长时间以稳定的速度骑行。
然而,你还必须加速超过你的阈值,以通过其他车手,当你向上移动一堆或顶山。
今天的锻炼重点是稳步的训练段,穿插着短暂的加速。
将冲刺工作纳入稳定状态的训练段将招募更多的肌肉纤维,并扩大其有氧工作的能力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Many riding and racing often require you to ride at a steady tempo for long periods. However, you will also have to accelerate above your threshold to pass other riders as you move up the bunch or crest a hill. 

Today's workout focuses on steady efforts interspersed with short accelerations. Incorporating sprint efforts into a steady-state effort will recruit additional muscle fibres and extend their ability to work aerobically.

Name: Sweetspot #4
Description:
Today we are increasing the volume completed of Strength Endurance. After warming up, we will ramp up the power to be ready for the low cadence work.

Name: Sweetspot 6 minute
Description:
Sweetspot work is a great way to stress your body without accumulating massive fatigue. This type of work is ideal for maintaining the gains in fitness you have made. 

It's medium intensity, but the efforts are short, with functional recovery.

这是中等强度,但训练段是短暂的,功能恢复。

Name: Sweetspot Training
Description:
Sweetspot Training (SST) is the area that typically provides the Most Bang for your buck! It targets many key physiological regions at once in a short amount of time. 

SST training falls between Upper Zone 3 and Lower Zone 4. It is a balanced amount of intensity and duration that improves your FTP. 

Sweetspot intervals can generally be completed up to twice a week. Interval duration is typically long, between 5-20 minutes, with similar recovery periods.
ChineseDescription:
Sweetspot Training (SST) 是通常为你的巴克提供最大爆炸的区域!
它在短时间内同时针对许多关键的生理区域。
SST训练位于上区3和下区4之间。
这是一个平衡的强度和持续时间,改善您的FTP。
甜点间歇通常可以每周完成两次。
间歇时间通常很长,在5-20分钟之间,有类似的恢复期。

Name: Swim and Easy Run
Description: Swim 1000 meters total, incorporating one set of 500 meters at a steady effort. In your other session of the day, run 20min easy at 55-65% of Max HR.

Name: Tadej's Criss-cross Tempo
Description: Train Like Tadej for the Giro-Tour Double with Criss-cross Tempo. This is a challenging session that tests both your aerobic and anaerobic energy systems. Criss-cross Tempo is a great session that simulates the demands of racing by forcing you to recover at a high power output. This session consists of 2x8min Criss-cross Tempo (1min at 95% FTP followed by 3min at 80% FTP) with 4min recovery.
ChineseDescription:
火车像Tadej的Giro-Tour双与交叉节奏。
这是一个具有挑战性的训练,测试您的有氧和无氧能量系统。
Criss-cross Tempo 是一个很棒的训练,通过迫使您以高功率输出恢复来模拟赛车的需求。
此训练包括2x8min的交叉速度(在95%的FTP下1min,在80%的FTP下3min)和4min恢复。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Train Like Tadej for the Giro-Tour Double with Criss-cross Tempo. This is a challenging session that tests both your aerobic and anaerobic energy systems. Criss-cross Tempo is a great session that simulates the demands of racing by forcing you to recover at a high power output. This session consists of 2x8min Criss-cross Tempo (1min at 95% FTP followed by 3min at 80% FTP) with 4min recovery.

Name: Tempo #7
Description:
There is no getting away from the benefits of completing long, steady tempo efforts. The best professionals spend countless hours training this way. 

To help the time pass and add another stress, the cadence varies from 75rpm for 1min to 90rpm for the next 4min. Complete the session with 2 x 2min Max Aerobic intervals.

使用 2 x 2min Max 有氧运动间歇完成训练。

Name: Tempo #8
Description:
A low-intensity session that focuses on building endurance. However, the key to today's session is the fuel source. Lactate becomes the preferred fuel source by completing short 15sec high-intensity surges above your threshold. 

Today's session is a high carbohydrate burning workout without the prolonged high intensity. This workout trains our bodies to use lactate more efficiently and gain endurance.

一个低强度的训练,专注于建立耐力。

通过完成超过阈值的15秒高强度浪涌,乳酸成为首选燃料来源。
今天的训练是一个高碳水化合物燃烧锻炼没有长时间的高强度。
这种锻炼训练我们的身体更有效地使用乳酸,并获得耐力。

Description:

The intensity is low enough that the interval can be completed comfortably yet creates enough stress to improve aerobic capabilities. The aim is to record the same HR response for both intervals.

强度足够低,可以舒适地完成间歇,但会产生足够的压力来提高有氧能力。
目的是在两个间歇内记录相同的HR响应。

Name: The Engine Builder 2 x 15min
Description:
Big fitness gains don't come from flashy efforts—they come from consistently building your aerobic engine.

This classic threshold workout features two sustained 15-minute efforts, gradually increasing from 95% to 100% of FTP. The progressive nature of each interval encourages smooth pacing, controlled execution, and the ability to hold strong power as fatigue begins to build.

The Engine Builder is designed to improve your FTP, increase your ability to sustain hard efforts, and develop the aerobic foundation needed for stronger climbing, faster racing, and better overall performance.

Focus Areas

FTP Development

Aerobic Capacity

Sustainable Power

Pacing Control

Endurance Performance

每个间歇的渐进性鼓励平稳的配速,控制执行,以及当疲劳开始形成时保持强大功率的能力。

Name: The Long View
Description:
Long aerobic passages help develop consistent pacing and sustained riding without repeated hard efforts. An easier passage offers a chance to relax before settling back into the work.

Today, we ride two long aerobic blocks after a steady lead-in, with an eight-minute easier passage between them. Keep the second block smooth and controlled.

Name: The Not so gentle squeeze
Description:
Think you've recovered? Think again.

This brutal VO2 Max session delivers twelve explosive 30-second efforts at 200% FTP, while recovery periods gradually shrink throughout the workout. The power stays the same, but the pressure keeps building.

Early intervals feel manageable, but as the session progresses you'll need to dig deeper, recover faster, and stay committed as fatigue begins to take hold.

Designed to improve your ability to produce repeated high-power efforts, this workout develops VO2 Max, anaerobic capacity, and the resilience needed to respond to attacks, accelerations, and decisive moments in racing.

Focus Areas

VO2 Max

Anaerobic Capacity

Repeatability

Race Fitness

Mental Toughness

Name: Three Small Hills
Description:
Brief, controlled changes of pace add variety while sustained aerobic riding remains the foundation of the session.

Today, we include three small hills with plenty of steady riding between them. Keep each lift measured, then settle back into your aerobic rhythm and finish with a long comfortable passage.

提高阈值功率的训练通常要么略低于或理想地进行,只是长时间高于阈值。
达到这个健身领域的最佳方法之一是在ERG模式下进行结构化的训练段。
你別無選擇,只能擊中功率!

Name: Threshold Block #1
Description:
After a good warmup, complete 2 x 4min Threshold efforts. However, the threshold effort ramps are ramping up or down over the 4min. 

Recovery time is 1min @ 65% FTP. This is the level at which lactate is cleared at its highest rate.

然而,阈值训练段坡道正在上升或下降超过4分钟。
恢复时间为1min @ 65% FTP。
这是乳酸以最高速率清除的水平。

Name: Threshold block #2
Description: A long threshold effort broken up by 1min recovery periods. However, after each recovery period the target cadence will change for the 5min threshold interval. How does the change in cadence affect your perceived effort for the same power?
ChineseDescription:
长时间的阈值训练段被1分钟的恢复期打破。

踏频的变化如何影响你对同一功率的感知训练段?

Name: Threshold Development
Description: Having a strong threshold is crucial to climbing performance. Whether your goal is to ride as a professional cyclist, or to get fitter, improving your threshold/FTP will help you on your journey. Today we will work on 'pushing' your FTP up from below and 'pulling' from above. Alternating cadences in the first interval will spike your heart rate whilst the external load (power) should remain stable.
ChineseDescription:
拥有强大的阈值对于攀爬性能至关重要。
无论您的目标是作为一名专业自行车手骑行,还是保持健康,提高阈值/FTP都将帮助您完成旅程。
今天,我们将训练段从下面“推”你的FTP,并从上面“拉”。
在第一个间歇的交替踏频会提高你的心率,而外部负载(功率)应该保持稳定。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Having a strong threshold is crucial to climbing performance. Whether your goal is to ride as a professional cyclist, or to get fitter, improving your threshold/FTP will help you on your journey. Today we will work on 'pushing' your FTP up from below and 'pulling' from above. Alternating cadences in the first interval will spike your heart rate whilst the external load (power) should remain stable.

Name: Threshold into all-out!
Description:
The racing demands will see you build up the power over an extended period before unleashing a short maximal effort. The intensity builds as you jostle for position, but you need to keep something in the tank for the decisive move. 

Today's workout does just this. We begin with a long effort from zone 3 up to the top of zone 4 before performing a hard 30sec effort.
ChineseDescription:
赛车需求将看到你在很长一段时间内积累功率,然后释放出短暂的最大训练段。
当你争夺位置时,强度会建立起来,但你需要在坦克中保留一些东西以进行决定性的动作。
今天的锻炼就是这样做的。
我们从3区到4区顶部的长时间训练段开始,然后进行30秒的艰苦训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
The racing demands will see you build up the power over an extended period before unleashing a short maximal effort. The intensity builds as you jostle for position, but you need to keep something in the tank for the decisive move. 

Today's workout does just this. We begin with a long effort from zone 3 up to the top of zone 4 before performing a hard 30sec effort.

Name: Threshold into Anaerobic Capacity
Description:
Anaerobic efforts are a guaranteed part of racing. They come thick and fast during the finale of a race, often being produced at a low cadence. 

Enhancing the race specificity of the workout, the anaerobic efforts are completed immediately after a 4min threshold effort.
ChineseDescription:
无氧训练段是赛车的保证部分。
它們在比賽的結局中變得厚而快速,經常以低節奏生產。
增强锻炼的种族特异性,无氧训练段在4分钟的阈值训练段后立即完成。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Time Trial Warm Up
Description: The goal of the TT warmup is to prepare you for the high intensity effort ahead. However, there is a fine line between warming up, and wasting energy that could be used in the TT. This carefully planned warmup will guide you through an appropriate warmup, consisting of varying intensity, that will have you ready to perform at your best. Aim to complete the warmup 10min before your start time.

这个精心策划的热身将引导你通过适当的热身,包括不同的强度,这将让你准备好在你最好的表现。
目标是在开始时间前10分钟完成热身。

Name: Torque Endurance
Description: Gravel racing often requires lots of time in a lower cadence, but because of the uneven surfaces, you often have to pedal more than on the road. Even when drafting, you have to keep the pressure on the pedals. This workout splits the cadences between low and high to build your torque endurance.

即使在起草时,你也必须保持踏板的压力。
这个锻炼将低和高的踏频分开,以建立你的扭矩耐力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Torque Steps
Description: Building on the Torque Endurance session earlier in the week. We go through various intervals. All are focussed on increasing your torque production.
ChineseDescription:
以本周早些时候的扭矩耐力赛为基础。
我们经历了不同的间歇。
所有这些都专注于增加您的扭矩生产。

Name: Train like Tadej - Short climbs
Description:
How does Tadej Pogacar train to perform those explosive race-winning attacks? This workout by the UAE Team Emirates coach focuses on VO2max power and the ability to repeat this.

The ability to perform race-winning efforts late in the race is critical to success. To achieve this, we begin with a long Zone 2 interval followed by high-intensity VO2max efforts.
ChineseDescription:
Tadej Pogacar如何训练来执行这些爆炸性的比赛胜利攻击?
阿联酋阿联酋队教练的这项训练侧重于VO2max的功率和重复这一点的能力。
在比赛后期进行比赛获胜的能力对于成功至关重要。
为了实现这一目标,我们从长的区域 2 间歇开始,然后进行高强度 VO2max 训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Train like Tadej - Threshold
Description:
How does Tadej Pogacar train to perform those long-range mountain attacks? This workout, designed by one of the coaches of the UAE Team Emirates, is intended to improve threshold power after first expending considerable energy.

There is no getting away from the benefits of long threshold efforts. They work! In this session, we build fatigue with the opening Zone 2 effort, then finish with 2 x 15min threshold intervals.
ChineseDescription:
Tadej Pogacar如何训练来执行这些远程山地攻击?
这项锻炼由阿联酋队的教练之一设计,旨在在首次消耗大量能量后提高阈值功率。
没有摆脱长期阈值训练段的好处。
他们工作!
在本节中,我们通过打开 Zone 2 的训练段来构建疲劳,然后以 2 x 15min 的阈值间歇结束。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Train like Tadej -Pre-race
Description:
How does Tadej Pogacar prepare for racing? This workout, designed by one of the coaches of the UAE Team Emirates, is the session completed the day before racing.

This is your opportunity to work through the same intervals that Tadej performs to prepare for a hard day of racing.

These efforts are designed as 'openers' to wake the legs from a rest period in preparation for high-intensity racing.
ChineseName: 像Tadej这样的火车 - 赛前
ChineseDescription:
Tadej Pogacar如何为赛车做准备?
这项锻炼由阿联酋队的教练之一设计,是在比赛前一天完成的。
这是你通过Tadej执行相同的间歇工作的机会,为艰难的一天赛车做准备。
这些训练段被设计为“开启者”,以将腿从休息期唤醒,为高强度比赛做准备。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

These efforts are designed as 'openers' to wake the legs from a rest period in preparation for high-intensity racing.

Name: Train with Tadej: Four by Four
Description:
Build your aerobic power with four 4-minute efforts at 110% FTP. A progressive warm-up prepares you for the work, with three minutes of easy pedalling between efforts and a gradual cooldown to finish.

Follow Tadej's coaching prompts as you focus on smooth pedalling, controlled starts and consistent pacing. Aim to make your final effort as well paced as your first. Use 90 rpm as a guide during the efforts and a comfortable cadence during recovery.
ChineseDescription:
在 110% FTP 下,通过 4 分钟的训练段建立您的有氧功率。
渐进式热身为您准备工作,在训练段和逐步冷却完成之间轻松踏板三分钟。
跟随Tadej的教练提示,你专注于平稳的踏板,可控的开始和一致的踏频。
旨在使您的最终训练段以及踏频作为您的第一次。
在训练段期间使用90 rpm作为指南,并在恢复期间保持舒适的踏频。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Build your aerobic power with four 4-minute efforts at 110% FTP. A progressive warm-up prepares you for the work, with three minutes of easy pedalling between efforts and a gradual cooldown to finish.

Follow Tadej's coaching prompts as you focus on smooth pedalling, controlled starts and consistent pacing. Aim to make your final effort as well paced as your first. Use 90 rpm as a guide during the efforts and a comfortable cadence during recovery.

Name: Train With Tadej: Tempo Builder
Description: Three sustained 12 minute tempo efforts at 89% FTP inspired by the original Train Like Tadej session. Use each recovery to reset, then aim to make your final effort as controlled and consistent as your first.
ChineseDescription:
三个持续12分钟的速度训练段在89%的FTP灵感来自原来的火车像Tadej训练。
使用每个恢复来重置,然后旨在使您的最终训练段像第一次一样受控和一致。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Train with Tadej: Tempo Express
Description: A shorter take on Train with Tadej tempo builder. Build gradually, then ride two controlled 7 minute tempo efforts at 89% FTP with an easy recovery between them. Focus on smooth pedalling and steady power all the way to the finish.
ChineseDescription:
乘坐Tadej节奏建设者的火车较短。
逐步构建,然后乘坐两个控制的7分钟速度训练段在89%的FTP之间轻松恢复。
专注于平稳的踏板和稳定的功率,直到完成。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Training Zones
Description: Understanding 'Training Zones' and their effect, will allow you to take your fitness journey to the next level. By completing efforts of varied duration and intensity, you will personalise training to meet your needs. Today we introduce the idea of different 'Training Zones' and the required intensity and length of efforts.
ChineseDescription:
了解“训练区”及其效果,将允许您将您的健身之旅提升到一个新的水平。
通过完成各种持续时间和强度的训练段,您将个性化的培训,以满足您的需求。
今天,我们介绍不同的“训练区”的想法,以及所需的强度和长度的训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Tri Endurance #1
Description:
To achieve a successful cycling performance, you need good endurance. Endurance training is about improving your capacity to endure sustained exercise. 

This endurance (or ability to endure) then helps form a solid base of fitness to build more race-specific training. By implementing carefully structured intensity into your endurance training, your ability to become more fatigue resistant is enhanced.
ChineseDescription:
为了实现成功的自行车性能,你需要良好的耐力。
耐力训练是关于提高你承受持续锻炼的能力。
然后,这种耐力(或忍受能力)有助于形成坚实的健身基础,以建立更多种族特定的训练。
通过在你的耐力训练中实施精心结构的强度,你变得更耐疲劳的能力得到了增强。

Name: Tri Tempo #1
Description:
There is no escaping the benefits of completing long, steady tempo intervals. These efforts aren't high intensity, but they elicit a feeling of sustainable discomfort when performed for an extended period! 

The intensity is well below threshold; however, it is hard enough that you will be generating a significant amount of lactate and forcing your body to process it. 

These workouts are also the ideal opportunity to ride in your race position, simulating the demands of racing.
ChineseDescription:
没有逃避完成长,稳定的速度间歇的好处。
这些训练段不是高强度的,但是当长时间执行时,它们会引起持续的不适感!
强度远低于阈值;然而,你很难产生大量的乳酸,并迫使你的身体处理它。
这些锻炼也是在你的比赛位置上骑行的理想机会,模拟赛车的需求。

Name: TT Power #2
Description: You are stepping up into the realms of Threshold power today. In this workout, we are working closer to your current FTP and increasing the workload. 你们今天正在加紧进入阈值功率的领域。
在这个锻炼中,我们正在更接近您当前的FTP并增加工作量。
在你的阈值下稳定的国家训练段会让你习惯于高强度的训练段。
短暂的恢复期正在为您准备更长的持续间歇。

Name: TT Speed #1
Description:
TT Speed sessions are all about becoming accustomed to the sensations of a TT effort. We aim to spend brief periods just below your current FTP setting with minimal recovery. 

The steady-state nature of these intervals will also introduce you to the feeling of laying down a consistent power. We achieve an excellent TT volume by completing the workload at shorter intervals with minimal fatigue.

Name: TT Steps
Description: Focusing on efforts that increase in intensity today. We are also looking at the repeatability of these efforts. Everyone is good on the 1st climb. We want you good on the last climb!
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
重点练习强度逐步增加的输出，以及重复完成这些输出的能力。不仅第1次爬坡要表现良好，也要争取在最后一次保持质量。

英文原文：
Focusing on efforts that increase in intensity today. We are also looking at the repeatability of these efforts. Everyone is good on the 1st climb. We want you good on the last climb!

Name: TT Steps
Description:
We are focusing on efforts that increase in intensity today. We are also looking at the repeatability of these efforts. 

Everyone is good on the 1st climb. We want you great on the last climb!
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
重点练习强度逐步增加的输出，以及重复完成这些输出的能力。不仅第1次爬坡要表现良好，也要争取在最后一次保持质量。

英文原文：
We are focusing on efforts that increase in intensity today. We are also looking at the repeatability of these efforts. 

Everyone is good on the 1st climb. We want you great on the last climb!

Name: Two Horizons
Description:
Changing the length and level of aerobic blocks can provide useful milestones while keeping the overall ride controlled.

Today, we ride two different aerobic circuits. The first climbs and returns to its starting level; the second uses different block lengths and finishes with seven steady minutes to settle your rhythm.
ChineseDescription:
改变有氧块的长度和水平可以提供有用的里程碑,同时保持整个骑行的控制。
今天,我们骑着两个不同的有氧电路。
第一个爬升并返回到起始水平;第二个使用不同的块长度,并以七个稳定的分钟结束,以固定你的节奏。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Changing the length and level of aerobic blocks can provide useful milestones while keeping the overall ride controlled.

Today, we ride two different aerobic circuits. The first climbs and returns to its starting level; the second uses different block lengths and finishes with seven steady minutes to settle your rhythm.

Name: Unclaimed prize
Description: Short on paper, but certainly not short on intensity!
ChineseDescription:
纸上短,但肯定不短强度!

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Short on paper, but certainly not short on intensity!

Name: Under One's
Description:
A challenging HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) session focuses on repeated efforts under One Minute. The workout consists of just 5 minutes of High-Intensity work. 

However, with short recovery periods, your lactate tolerance will be tested. 

The session is divided into three blocks of work. 12 x 10sec sprints with 50secs recovery. 6 x 15sec sprints with 45secs recovery. And 3 x 30sec sprints with 30sec recovery.
ChineseDescription:
一个具有挑战性的HIIT(高强度间歇训练)训练侧重于一分钟下的反复训练段。
锻炼只需5分钟的高强度工作。
然而,在短的恢复期,你的乳酸耐受性将被测试。
训练分为三个工作块。
12 x 10 秒冲刺,恢复 50 秒。
6 x 15秒冲刺,恢复45秒。
3 x 30sec 冲刺,30sec 恢复。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
A challenging HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) session focuses on repeated efforts under One Minute. The workout consists of just 5 minutes of High-Intensity work. 

However, with short recovery periods, your lactate tolerance will be tested. 

The session is divided into three blocks of work. 12 x 10sec sprints with 50secs recovery. 6 x 15sec sprints with 45secs recovery. And 3 x 30sec sprints with 30sec recovery.

Name: Under pressure
Description: We don't always get faster by training faster. Spending time at lower intensities is essential to improving performance.
ChineseDescription:
我们并不总是通过更快的训练来获得更快。
以较低的强度花费时间对于提高性能至关重要。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
We don't always get faster by training faster. Spending time at lower intensities is essential to improving performance.

Name: Up and Down
Description: Varying your aerobic intensity can help keep shorter endurance sessions engaging while still providing plenty of controlled aerobic work. Today, we move up and down through a series of aerobic targets. Focus on responding smoothly to each change in intensity while keeping the overall effort comfortable and controlled.
ChineseDescription:
改变你的有氧强度可以帮助保持较短的耐力赛的吸引力,同时仍然提供大量的可控的有氧工作。
今天,我们通过一系列有氧目标上下移动。
专注于平稳地响应强度的每个变化,同时保持整体训练段舒适和可控。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Varying your aerobic intensity can help keep shorter endurance sessions engaging while still providing plenty of controlled aerobic work. Today, we move up and down through a series of aerobic targets. Focus on responding smoothly to each change in intensity while keeping the overall effort comfortable and controlled.

Name: Up We Go, Down We Chill
Description: This active recovery session maintains a steady, low-intensity workload to enhance blood flow and metabolic clearance. Keep breathing relaxed and cadence consistent, holding a flat effort to support muscle recovery without adding physiological stress.
ChineseName: 專輯名稱:Up We Go, Down We Chill
ChineseDescription:
这种主动恢复训练保持稳定,低强度的工作量,以提高血液流动和代谢清除率。
保持呼吸放松和踏频一致,保持平坦的训练段,以支持肌肉恢复而不会增加生理压力。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
This active recovery session maintains a steady, low-intensity workload to enhance blood flow and metabolic clearance. Keep breathing relaxed and cadence consistent, holding a flat effort to support muscle recovery without adding physiological stress.

Name: V02max 2min
Description: Big session today! We open with 2 x 2min VO2 efforts. However, the target power steadily decreases from 'very hard' to just 'hard'. The workout concludes with a 6min effort featuring the same steady decrease in target power.
ChineseDescription:
今天的大训练!
我们以2 x 2min VO2的训练段开放。
然而,目标功率从“非常硬”稳步下降至“硬”。
锻炼以6分钟的训练段结束,目标功率同样稳步下降。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Big session today! We open with 2 x 2min VO2 efforts. However, the target power steadily decreases from 'very hard' to just 'hard'. The workout concludes with a 6min effort featuring the same steady decrease in target power.

Name: V02max 3min & 2min
Description:
Working through the range of Zone 5 today. The opening 3-minute intervals are at the lower end of Zone 5. In contrast, the final intervals are 2 minutes in duration at the top end of Zone 5. 

The ability to recover from high-intensity V02max efforts is an essential cycling component.
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
本课覆盖第5区的不同强度：前段为第5区较低端的3分钟间歇，最后为第5区较高端的2分钟间歇。练习从高强度最大摄氧量训练中恢复的能力。

英文原文：
Working through the range of Zone 5 today. The opening 3-minute intervals are at the lower end of Zone 5. In contrast, the final intervals are 2 minutes in duration at the top end of Zone 5. 

The ability to recover from high-intensity V02max efforts is an essential cycling component.

Name: V02max 3min & 2min
Description: Working through the range of Zone 5 today. The opening 3 minute intervals are at the lower end of Zone 5. While the final intervals are 2 minutes in duration at the top end of Zone 5. The ability to recover from high intensity V02max efforts isan important component of cycling.
ChineseDescription:
今天在5区的范围内工作。
开场时间间歇为3分钟,位于5区的下端。
而最终的间歇时间为2分钟,在区域5的顶部。
从高强度V02max训练段中恢复的能力是骑自行车的重要组成部分。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: V02max 3min and 2min
Description: Working through the range of Zone 5 today. The opening 3-minute intervals are at the lower end of Zone 5. In contrast, the final intervals are 2 minutes in duration at the top end of Zone 5.

英文原文：
Working through the range of Zone 5 today. The opening 3-minute intervals are at the lower end of Zone 5. In contrast, the final intervals are 2 minutes in duration at the top end of Zone 5.

Name: V02max climbing #1
Description: Simulating the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity, today you will complete 5 x 3min intervals, followed by 3 x 2min intervals. However, the target cadence is reduced from 85rpm in the 3min intervals to 70rpm in the 2min intervals. Complete the 3min intervals seated and the 2min intervals standing if possible.
ChineseDescription:
模拟以V02max强度攀登的要求,今天您将完成5 x 3min的间歇,然后是3 x 2min的间歇。
但是,目标踏频从3min间歇的85rpm减少到2min间歇的70rpm。
如果可能的话,请完成3分钟的间歇并保持2分钟的间歇。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Simulating the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity, today you will complete 5 x 3min intervals, followed by 3 x 2min intervals. However, the target cadence is reduced from 85rpm in the 3min intervals to 70rpm in the 2min intervals. Complete the 3min intervals seated and the 2min intervals standing if possible.

Name: V02max Declining 6min
Description: Working at the lower end of your Zone 5 V02max power, this session requires you to complete the longest interval first, then reduce the following interval by 30sec each time. Starting with a 6min Zone 5 interval, you will finish with a 3.5min interval.
ChineseDescription:
在 Zone 5 V02max 功率的下端工作,此训练要求您先完成最长间歇,然后每次将以下间歇减少 30 秒。
从6min Zone 5区间开始,您将以3.5min区间结束。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Working at the lower end of your Zone 5 V02max power, this session requires you to complete the longest interval first, then reduce the following interval by 30sec each time. Starting with a 6min Zone 5 interval, you will finish with a 3.5min interval.

Name: V02max Declining 6min
Description:
Working at the lower end of your Zone 5 V02max power, this session requires you to complete the most prolonged interval first, then reduce the following interval by 30sec each time. 

Starting with a 6min Zone 5 interval, you will finish with a 3.5min interval.
ChineseDescription:
在 Zone 5 V02max 功率的低端工作,此训练要求您首先完成最长时间的间歇,然后每次将以下间歇减少 30 秒。
从6min Zone 5区间开始,您将以3.5min区间结束。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Working at the lower end of your Zone 5 V02max power, this session requires you to complete the most prolonged interval first, then reduce the following interval by 30sec each time. 

Starting with a 6min Zone 5 interval, you will finish with a 3.5min interval.

Name: V02max Increase #1
Description:
Today's session simulates the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity by targeting a lower cadence. Five intervals at Lower Zone 5. However, each interval is extended by 30sec. 

The 1st effort is 4 minutes, then extend each effort by 30 seconds (the last effort is 6 minutes).
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
用较低踏频模拟最大摄氧量强度的爬坡。完成5次第5区较低端的间歇：第1次4分钟，此后每次延长30秒，最后一次6分钟。

英文原文：
Today's session simulates the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity by targeting a lower cadence. Five intervals at Lower Zone 5. However, each interval is extended by 30sec. 

The 1st effort is 4 minutes, then extend each effort by 30 seconds (the last effort is 6 minutes).

Name: V02max Increase #1
Description: Today's session simulates the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity, by targeting a lower cadence. 5 intervals at Lower Zone 5. However, each interval is extended by 30sec. The 1st effort is 4 minutes then extend each effort by 30 seconds (last effort is 6 minutes).
ChineseDescription:
今天的训练模拟了V02max强度的攀登需求,通过瞄准较低的踏频。
5 次在下区 5 次间歇。
然而,每个间歇被延长30秒。
第1次训练段是4分钟,然后将每次训练段延长30秒(最后训练段是6分钟)。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
Today's session simulates the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity, by targeting a lower cadence. 5 intervals at Lower Zone 5. However, each interval is extended by 30sec. The 1st effort is 4 minutes then extend each effort by 30 seconds (last effort is 6 minutes).

Name: V02max Increase Climb
Description: Today's session simulates the demands of climbing at a V02max intensity, by targeting a lower cadence. 5 intervals at Lower Zone 5. However, each interval is extended by 30sec. The 1st effort is 4 minutes then extend each effort by 30 seconds (last effort is 6 minutes).
ChineseDescription:

Name: V02max x 3min
Description: After warming up, the session will focus on completing two 3-minute VO2max intervals. However, we first build some fatigue through Zone 2 riding.
ChineseDescription:
升温后,训练将专注于完成两个3分钟VO2max间歇。
然而,我们首先通过2区骑行来制造一些疲劳。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】
After warming up, the session will focus on completing two 3-minute VO2max intervals. However, we first build some fatigue through Zone 2 riding.

Name: VO2 Launch Lets Go
Description:
Ready to push your limits?

This workout introduces one of the most effective ways to improve your aerobic power and raise your fitness ceiling. Five sustained efforts at 112% of FTP challenge your cardiovascular system, helping you develop the ability to ride harder for longer.

The recoveries are generous enough to allow quality efforts throughout the session, making this an ideal introduction to VO2 Max training.

Focus Areas

VO2 Max Development

Aerobic Power

High-Intensity Fitness

Climbing Performance
ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
通过5次持续输出、目标112% FTP的训练挑战心肺系统，提高有氧功率和持续高强度骑行能力。恢复时间较充足，以保持每次输出质量，适合作为最大摄氧量训练的入门课程。

英文原文：
Ready to push your limits?

This workout introduces one of the most effective ways to improve your aerobic power and raise your fitness ceiling. Five sustained efforts at 112% of FTP challenge your cardiovascular system, helping you develop the ability to ride harder for longer.

The recoveries are generous enough to allow quality efforts throughout the session, making this an ideal introduction to VO2 Max training.

Focus Areas

VO2 Max Development

Aerobic Power

High-Intensity Fitness

Climbing Performance

Name: VO2 Max #1 + Swim
Description:
By working just above Threshold in Zone 4 and into Zone 5, we can improve our VO2max abilities and increase our Threshold. These are high-intensity efforts, so the intervals are broken down into shorter work periods. 

A well developed VO2max system will allow you to recover from high-intensity efforts faster and increase endurance.

For your swim session, complete 750 meters total, incorporating one set of 300 meters at a steady effort.
ChineseDescription:
通过在区域4的阈值和区域5的工作,我们可以提高我们的VO2max能力,并提高我们的阈值。
这些是高强度的训练段,因此间歇被分解为较短的工作周期。
一个发达的VO2max系统可以让你更快地从高强度的训练段中恢复,并增加耐力。
为您的游泳训练,完成750米的总,结合一套300米的稳定训练段。

Name: Wait for me
Description: Long steady efforts are fine on their own. They take on a whole different meaning by completing a series of sprints before them.

Name: What are Intervals?
Description:
Intervals play an essential part in your training. They increase fitness and allow you to burn more calories over a short period than steady-state riding. In cycling, we use the word 'Intervals' to define periods of higher intensity work alternating with low-intensity periods of recovery. 

Today we look at different ways of completing interval workouts and why we need them.
ChineseDescription:
间歇在你的训练中起着至关重要的作用。
它们可以增加健身量,并允许您在短时间内燃烧比稳定状态骑行更多的卡路里。
在循环中,我们使用“间歇”一词来定义高强度工作与低强度恢复周期交替的时期。
今天,我们来看看完成间歇锻炼的不同方法以及为什么我们需要它们。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: What are Training Zones?
Description:
Understanding 'Training Zones' and their use will allow you to take your fitness journey to the next level. By completing varied duration and intensity efforts, you will personalise training to meet your needs. 

Today we introduce the idea of different 'Training Zones' and the required intensity and length of efforts.

通过完成不同的持续时间和强度训练段,您将个性化的培训,以满足您的需求。
今天,我们介绍不同的“训练区”的想法,以及所需的强度和长度的训练段。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: What is FTP?
Description: Functional Threshold Power (FTP) represents your ability to maintain the highest possible power for 1 hour. Regular assessment of FTP gives an indication of whether you are improving your fitness. Your training zones are based on a percentage of FTP, ensuring that each workout is personalised for your needs.
ChineseDescription:
功能阈值功率(FTP)代表您保持最高功率1小时的能力。
定期评估FTP表明您是否正在改善您的健康状况。
您的训练区域基于 FTP 的百分比,确保每个锻炼都根据您的需要进行个性化。

Name: What is Sweetspot Training?
Description:
Sweetspot Training (SST) is the area that typically provides the Most Bang for your buck! It targets many key physiological regions at once in a short amount of time. SST training falls between Upper Zone 3 and Lower Zone 4. 

It is a balanced amount of intensity and duration that improves your FTP. Sweetspot intervals can generally be completed up to twice a week. Interval duration is typically long, between 5-20 minutes, with similar recovery periods.
ChineseDescription:

SST训练位于上区3和下区4之间。
这是一个平衡的强度和持续时间,改善您的FTP。
甜点间歇通常可以每周完成两次。
间歇时间通常很长,在5-20分钟之间,有类似的恢复期。

Name: What must be done
Description: Stepped intervals require you to progress your way through the various Zones. The duration of each interval is decreased as the intensity increases.
ChineseDescription:
步进的间歇要求您通过各种区域进行进度。
每个间歇的持续时间随着强度的增加而减少。

Name: Winding Roads
Description:
Rolling aerobic effort can keep a longer indoor ride engaging while the overall intensity stays controlled. Different rises and descents give you a reason to adjust your rhythm smoothly.

Today, we follow three different gentle rolls, with sustained aerobic riding between them and a steady finish. Respond gradually to the terrain and avoid surging.
ChineseDescription:
滚动有氧运动可以保持较长的室内骑行参与,同时整体强度保持控制。
不同的上升和下降会给你一个顺利调整节奏的理由。
今天,我们遵循三种不同的柔和卷,它们之间持续有氧骑行和稳定的完成。
逐步应对地形,避免飙升。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Description: After completing 25min @ Zone 2 Endurance, you will complete 2 x Capacity intervals that climb from 88-130% FTP over 2min.

ChineseDescription:
中文要点：
先在第2区完成25分钟耐力训练，再完成2次2分钟的能力间歇，每次功率在2分钟内从88% FTP逐步升至130% FTP。

英文原文：

Name: Zone 2 into 30/15's
Description:
This session consists of alternating work periods of 30 seconds at high intensity and recovery periods of 15 seconds, where low-intensity work is performed. 

After warming up, you will complete 35min @ Zone 2 Endurance, followed by 10 x 30sec on / 15sec off. The workout will challenge your ability to spend a significant amount of time above 90% of VO2 Max. However, the set opens with a 3min threshold effort.
ChineseDescription:
本次训练包括交替工作时间为30秒,在高强度和恢复时间为15秒,其中进行低强度工作。
热身后,您将完成35分钟@区域2耐力,然后10 x 30sec on / 15sec off。
锻炼将挑战你花费大量时间超过VO2 Max 90%的能力。
但是,设置以3分钟的阈值训练段打开。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Zone 2 into Max Aerobic
Description:
After a good warm-up, we are going to build some endurance and fatigue before preparing yourself for a Max Aerobic interval. We can't always start the intervals with fresh legs. 

The session provides a different training stimulus by including some Zone 2 endurance before the high-intensity work.
ChineseName: 区域 2 到 最大强度 Aerobic
ChineseDescription:
在良好的热身之后,我们将建立一些耐力和疲劳,然后准备自己的最大有氧间歇。
我们不能总是用新鲜的腿开始间歇。
该课程通过在高强度工作之前包括一些区域2耐力来提供不同的训练刺激。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Name: Zone 2 into Race Attack
Description:
This is your day to finish the race strongly! But first, we will complete some Zone 2 endurance work to build up some fatigue. After all, racing is about producing maximal efforts when the legs have already completed some hard work. 

While performing these efforts, visualise yourself attacking the winning break of the day!
ChineseDescription:
今天是您强烈完成比赛的日子!
但首先,我们将完成一些Zone 2耐力工作,以增加一些疲劳。
毕竟,赛车是关于在腿部已经完成一些艰苦的工作时产生最大的训练段。
在执行这些训练段的同时,想象自己攻击当天的胜利休息!

Name: Zone 2 into Threshold
Description: After a good warmup complete 2 x 5min Threshold efforts. However, the threshold effort ramps up from low to high threshold over the 5min. Recovery time is 1min @ 65% FTP. This is the level at which lactate is cleared at it's highest rate.
ChineseDescription:
经过良好的热身完成2×5分钟阈值的训练段。
然而,阈值训练段在5分钟内从低阈值增加到高阈值。
恢复时间为1min @ 65% FTP。
这是乳酸以最高速率清除的水平。

【以上为自动翻译，英文原文供核对】

Spending time in Zone 2 is essential to improving performance. By completing the session with steady-state power, we can make other observations about your performance, including heart rate and lactate response.

Description: This session will allow you to maintain your base fitness by touching on some short, high intensity intervals. By completing 6 x 1min intervals with good recovery, you will keep those fast twitch muscle fibers in check for when the intensity begins.

此训练将允许您通过触摸一些短,高强度的间歇来保持您的基本健康。

Description:
Long Steady Tempo efforts on their own are effective training. But by incorporating 30-second high-intensity efforts into them, you will improve your body's ability to work aerobically for long periods. 

Today's sessions consist of a 12-minute Tempo effort with a 30-second surge every 3.5 minutes.

Name: Zone 2 with Threshold #1
Description: Everyone is good when fresh. The critical point is to be good when fatigued! In this workout, we will build some fatigue through a controlled Zone 2 effort, before completing a 6-minute Threshold interval. NOTE: The zone 2 work is completed as a free-ride, before returning to a controlled interval to finish the session.

注意: 区域 2 工作以自由骑行方式完成,然后返回到受控间歇以完成训练。

Name: Zone 3 Volume
Description:
Zone 3 training is ideal for building muscular endurance during the late base phase of training. To train this area effectively requires completing longer medium intensity intervals. When completing long climbs, you will more than likely be spending a considerable amount of time at this intensity. 

Today's session consists of 3 x 12 minute Zone 3 intervals.
ChineseDescription:
3区训练是训练后期基础阶段建立肌肉耐力的理想选择。
要有效地训练这个区域,需要完成更长的中等强度间歇。
当完成长时间的攀登时,你很可能会在这个强度上花费相当长的时间。
今天的训练包括3 x 12 分钟 Zone 3 间歇。
